+    def _parse_optional_fee(value: Any, field_name: str) -> Decimal | None:
+        """Preserve missing fees and apply shared cents normalization to supplied amounts."""
+        if value is None or (isinstance(value, str) and not value.strip()):
+            return None

+            decimal_value = Decimal(str(value).strip())
+        except InvalidOperation as exc:
+            raise ValueError(f"{field_name} must be numeric") from exc

+        except InvalidInputError as exc:
+            raise ValueError(f"{field_name} is invalid: {exc}") from exc
+        if normalized is None:

@@ -0,0 +1,143 @@
+"""Application use cases for the transaction-record API candidate."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from datetime import datetime
+from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal, InvalidOperation
+
+from apps.account.application.repository_provider import get_transaction_record_repository
+from apps.account.application.transaction_cost_use_cases import (
+    normalize_actual_fee,
+)
+from apps.account.domain.transaction_record_contracts import (
+    CreateTransactionInput,
+    NewTransactionRecord,
+    TransactionPage,
+    TransactionRecord,
+    TransactionRecordRepositoryProtocol,
+)
+from core.exceptions import InvalidInputError
+
+CENT = Decimal("0.01")
+PRICE_QUANTUM = Decimal("0.0001")
+MAX_PRICE = Decimal("9999999999999999.9999")
+MAX_NOTIONAL = Decimal("999999999999999999.99")
+MAX_SHARES = 1_000_000_000_000
+
+
+def _validate_positive_id(value: int, *, field_name: str) -> None:
+    """Require an actual positive integer identifier, excluding booleans."""
+
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value <= 0:
+        raise InvalidInputError("编号必须为正整数", details={"field": field_name})
+
+
+class CreateTransactionUseCase:
+    """Create one transaction after deriving its notional in Application."""
+
+    def __init__(self, repository: TransactionRecordRepositoryProtocol | None = None) -> None:
+        self.repository = repository or get_transaction_record_repository()
+
+    def execute(self, command: CreateTransactionInput) -> TransactionRecord:
+        """Normalize the computed notional and persist through the typed port."""
+        _validate_positive_id(command.actor_user_id, field_name="actor_user_id")
+        _validate_positive_id(command.portfolio_id, field_name="portfolio_id")
+        if command.position_id is not None:
+            _validate_positive_id(command.position_id, field_name="position_id")
+
+        if isinstance(command.shares, bool) or not isinstance(command.shares, (int, float)):
+            raise InvalidInputError("交易数量必须为正有限数", details={"field": "shares"})
+        try:
+            shares = float(command.shares)
+        except (OverflowError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+            raise InvalidInputError("交易数量必须为正有限数", details={"field": "shares"}) from exc
+        if not math.isfinite(shares) or shares <= 0 or shares > MAX_SHARES:
+            raise InvalidInputError(
+                "交易数量必须为允许范围内的正有限数", details={"field": "shares"}
+            )
+
+        if (
+            not isinstance(command.price, Decimal)
+            or not command.price.is_finite()
+            or command.price <= 0
+        ):
+            raise InvalidInputError("成交价格必须为正有限金额", details={"field": "price"})
+        try:
+            price = command.price.quantize(PRICE_QUANTUM, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
+            notional = (Decimal(str(shares)) * price).quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
+        except InvalidOperation as exc:
+            raise InvalidInputError(
+                "成交价格或金额超出允许范围", details={"field": "price"}
+            ) from exc
+        if price <= 0 or price > MAX_PRICE:
+            raise InvalidInputError("成交价格超出允许范围", details={"field": "price"})
+        if notional > MAX_NOTIONAL:
+            raise InvalidInputError("成交金额超出允许范围", details={"field": "shares"})
+        if not isinstance(command.action, str) or command.action not in ("buy", "sell"):
+            raise InvalidInputError("交易方向无效", details={"field": "action"})
+
+        commission = normalize_actual_fee(command.commission, field_name="commission")
+        slippage = normalize_actual_fee(command.slippage, field_name="slippage")
+        stamp_duty = normalize_actual_fee(command.stamp_duty, field_name="stamp_duty")
+        transfer_fee = normalize_actual_fee(command.transfer_fee, field_name="transfer_fee")
+
+        if (
+            not isinstance(command.traded_at, datetime)
+            or command.traded_at.tzinfo is None
+            or command.traded_at.utcoffset() is None
+        ):
+            raise InvalidInputError(
+                "成交时间必须为带时区的 datetime",
+                details={"field": "traded_at"},
+            )
+
+        return self.repository.create_transaction(
+            NewTransactionRecord(
+                actor_user_id=command.actor_user_id,
+                portfolio_id=command.portfolio_id,
+                position_id=command.position_id,
+                action=command.action,
+                asset_code=command.asset_code,
+                shares=shares,
+                price=price,
+                notional=notional,
+                notes=command.notes,
+                traded_at=command.traded_at,
+                commission=commission,
+                slippage=slippage,
+                stamp_duty=stamp_duty,
+                transfer_fee=transfer_fee,
+            )
+        )
+
+
+class ListTransactionPageUseCase:
+    """Read one owner-scoped transaction page."""
+
+    def __init__(self, repository: TransactionRecordRepositoryProtocol | None = None) -> None:
+        self.repository = repository or get_transaction_record_repository()
+
+    def execute(self, *, user_id: int, page_number: int, page_size: int) -> TransactionPage:
+        """Return a typed page using the API's selected pagination values."""
+        _validate_positive_id(user_id, field_name="user_id")
+        _validate_positive_id(page_number, field_name="page")
+        _validate_positive_id(page_size, field_name="page_size")
+        return self.repository.list_user_transactions(
+            user_id,
+            page_number=page_number,
+            page_size=page_size,
+        )
+
+
+class GetTransactionUseCase:
+    """Read a single transaction inside the authenticated user's scope."""
+
+    def __init__(self, repository: TransactionRecordRepositoryProtocol | None = None) -> None:
+        self.repository = repository or get_transaction_record_repository()
+
+    def execute(self, *, user_id: int, transaction_id: int) -> TransactionRecord | None:

+"""Pure variance calculation for the fee-availability candidate."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+from apps.account.domain.transaction_cost_contracts import TransactionCostRecord
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TransactionCostVariance:
+    """Current actual-versus-estimated variance and its optional fraction."""
+
+    cost_variance: Decimal | None
+    cost_variance_pct: float | None
+
+
+def canonical_fee_amount(amount: Decimal | None, known: bool | None) -> Decimal | None:
+    """Expose an amount only when its collection state is explicitly true."""
+    return amount if known is True else None
+
+
+def complete_actual_cost(record: TransactionCostRecord) -> Decimal | None:
+    """Sum actual fees only when every component is explicitly known."""
+    if (
+        record["commission_known"] is not True
+        or record["commission"] is None
+        or record["slippage_known"] is not True
+        or record["slippage"] is None
+        or record["stamp_duty_known"] is not True
+        or record["stamp_duty"] is None
+        or record["transfer_fee_known"] is not True
+        or record["transfer_fee"] is None
+    ):
+        return None
+    return record["commission"] + record["slippage"] + record["stamp_duty"] + record["transfer_fee"]
+
+
+def derive_actual_cost_variance(record: TransactionCostRecord) -> TransactionCostVariance:
+    """Derive variance only from a complete, explicitly known actual-fee set."""
+    actual = complete_actual_cost(record)
+    if actual is None:
+        return TransactionCostVariance(cost_variance=None, cost_variance_pct=None)
+
+    estimate = record["estimated_cost"]
+    if estimate is None:
+        return TransactionCostVariance(cost_variance=None, cost_variance_pct=None)
+
+    variance = actual - estimate
+    variance_pct = float(variance / estimate) if estimate > 0 else None
+    return TransactionCostVariance(cost_variance=variance, cost_variance_pct=variance_pct)

+### 9.2 交易费用可用性与响应契约
+
+`/api/account/transactions/` 是现有交易记录入口：GET 返回当前用户范围内的分页列表，POST 创建交易；`/api/account/transactions/{id}/` 的 GET 返回当前用户范围内的单笔记录。创建请求中的 `portfolio` 是旧 Account `PortfolioModel` 主键，`position` 是旧 Account `PositionModel` 主键；这两个字段不接受 canonical `SimulatedAccount` / `account_id`。创建请求先验证组合归属，再检查可选持仓；当组合和持仓均不属于当前用户时，优先返回组合归属拒绝。费用字段随交易记录读写，不新增费用汇总 API。
+
+创建请求中的 `commission`、`slippage`、`stamp_duty`、`transfer_fee` 均为可选非负金额。省略、`null` 或空字符串表示未知；显式 `0` 表示已知的零金额。客户端提交的 `*_known` 字段由服务端控制，会被忽略，不能用来声明费用已采集。
+
+HTTP 创建和后台修正表单的费用最多接受两位小数，单项上限为 `99999999.99`。手工成交导入对已提供的费用按分使用 `ROUND_HALF_UP` 归一化，并在舍入后检查同一上限；例如 `0.005` 为 `0.01`，`0.004` 为已采集的 `0.00`。缺失或空白不参与舍入，原始导入文本保留在审计字段中。
+
+响应中的金额和可用性标记按以下语义配对：
+
+| `*_known` | 费用金额 | 含义 |
+|---|---|---|
+| `true` | JSON decimal 字符串（例如 "0.00"，包括零） | 已采集的实际费用 |
+| `false` | `null` | 明确未采集；底层占位值不作为实际金额返回 |
+| `null` | `null` | 可用状态未声明/未知（包括历史记录或未显式设置状态的记录） |
+
+创建成功仍返回 HTTP `201`，保留现有响应字段并返回四项费用及只读 `*_known` 标记；响应不增加 `id`。`GET` 列表和详情返回相同的费用/标记语义。
+
+| 状态码 | 边界 |
+|---|---|
+| `400` | 请求字段不合法，例如费用为负数，或组合/持仓引用无效。 |
+| `403` | 已认证用户没有相应交易权限，或不能在目标组合/持仓下创建交易。 |
+| `404` | 交易详情不存在或不属于当前用户；无效详情 ID 也按未找到处理。 |
+| `405` | 该交易 API 不支持的 HTTP 方法；交易记录保持追加式，详情不支持 PATCH/DELETE。 |
+
+后台“修正交易费用”入口允许逐项修正：留空表示保留该项原值和状态，输入 `0` 表示已知的零金额；至少提交一项费用。历史字段迁移只添加可空状态，不从旧占位值或估算值推断实际费用。迁移到账本时，已存在映射的交易按幂等规则跳过；对尚未映射的交易，只有四项 `*_known` 全部为 `true` 才迁移，否则跳过并计入未知费用跳过数。
+
+这些费用值保留记录中的原始金额口径；当前接口不做币种换算或人民币归一。当前公开 Account 交易接口提供记录创建、列表和详情，不提供费用聚合端点。

+def _transaction_payload(portfolio_id: int, **overrides: object) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Build a valid ordinary transaction request before applying one test case."""
+
+    return {
+        "portfolio": portfolio_id,
+        "action": "buy",
+        "asset_code": "600000.SH",
+        "shares": 10,
+        "price": "9.5000",
+        "traded_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
+        **overrides,
+    }

+def _create_position(portfolio: PortfolioModel, asset_code: str) -> PositionModel:
+    """Create a real owned position for cross-owner and mismatch requests."""
+
+    return PositionModel.objects.create(
+        portfolio=portfolio,
+        asset_code=asset_code,
+        asset_class="equity",
+        region="CN",
+        cross_border="domestic",
+        shares=10,
+        avg_cost=Decimal("9.0000"),
+        current_price=Decimal("9.5000"),
+        market_value=Decimal("95.00"),
+        unrealized_pnl=Decimal("5.00"),
+        unrealized_pnl_pct=5.0,
+    )

+def _create_transaction(
+    portfolio: PortfolioModel,
+    *,
+    traded_at: datetime,
+    asset_code: str = "600000.SH",
+    **fields: object,
+) -> TransactionModel:
+    """Insert a real transaction row with explicit test-owned values."""
+
+    return TransactionModel.objects.create(
+        portfolio=portfolio,
+        action="buy",
+        asset_code=asset_code,
+        shares=10,
+        price=Decimal("9.5000"),
+        notional=Decimal("95.00"),
+        traded_at=traded_at,
+        **fields,
+    )
+

+def _schema_component(schema: dict[str, Any], schema_node: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Resolve one generated OpenAPI component reference for assertions."""
+    assert isinstance(schema_node, dict)
+    reference = schema_node.get("$ref")
+    assert isinstance(reference, str)
+    components = schema.get("components")
+    assert isinstance(components, dict)
+    schemas = components.get("schemas")
+    assert isinstance(schemas, dict)
+    component = schemas.get(reference.rsplit("/", 1)[-1])
+    assert isinstance(component, dict)
+    return component
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fee_field", FEE_FIELDS)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("input_kind", "input_value", "is_valid", "expected"),
+    [
+        ("missing", None, True, None),
+        ("null", None, True, None),
+        ("blank", "", True, None),
+        ("explicit_zero", "0.00", True, Decimal("0.00")),
+    ],
+)
+def test_create_serializer_uses_is_valid_for_each_fee_input_state(
+    owned_portfolio: PortfolioModel,
+    fee_field: str,
+    input_kind: str,
+    input_value: object,
+    is_valid: bool,
+    expected: Decimal | None,
+) -> None:
+    """Omitted/null/blank fees stay unknown, while explicit zero remains known."""
+
+    payload = _transaction_payload(owned_portfolio.id)
+    if input_kind != "missing":
+        payload[fee_field] = input_value
+
+    serializer = TransactionCreateSerializer(data=payload)
+
+    assert serializer.is_valid() is is_valid
+    if not is_valid:
+        assert fee_field in serializer.errors
+        return
+
+    assert serializer.validated_data[fee_field] == expected
+    assert all(
+        serializer.validated_data[other_field] is None
+        for other_field in FEE_FIELDS
+        if other_field != fee_field
+    )
+

+) -> None:

+    payload = _transaction_payload(

+        stamp_duty="1.20",
+        transfer_fee="0.00",
+        commission_known=False,
+        slippage_known=True,
+        stamp_duty_known=False,
+        transfer_fee_known=False,
+    )
+    serializer = TransactionCreateSerializer(data=payload)
+
+    assert serializer.is_valid(), serializer.errors
+    assert serializer.validated_data["commission"] == Decimal("0.00")
+    assert serializer.validated_data["slippage"] is None
+    assert serializer.validated_data["stamp_duty"] == Decimal("1.20")
+    assert serializer.validated_data["transfer_fee"] == Decimal("0.00")
+    assert all(f"{field}_known" not in serializer.validated_data for field in FEE_FIELDS)

+            slippage_known=True,

+        ),
+        format="json",
+    )
+
+    assert response.status_code == 201
+    assert response["Content-Type"].startswith("application/json")
+    payload = response.json()
+    assert "id" not in payload
+    assert "notional" not in payload
+    assert payload["portfolio"] == owned_portfolio.id
+    assert payload["position"] is None
+    assert payload["action"] == "buy"
+    assert payload["asset_code"] == "600000.SH"
+    assert payload["shares"] == 10.0
+    assert payload["price"] == "9.5000"
+    assert payload["notes"] == "fee availability"
+    assert payload["traded_at"]
+    assert {
+        "commission": (payload["commission"], payload["commission_known"]),
+        "slippage": (payload["slippage"], payload["slippage_known"]),
+        "stamp_duty": (payload["stamp_duty"], payload["stamp_duty_known"]),
+        "transfer_fee": (payload["transfer_fee"], payload["transfer_fee_known"]),

+        "commission": ("0.00", True),

+    assert record.stamp_duty == Decimal("2.50")

+def test_postgres_owner_change_while_waiting_is_rechecked_under_lock() -> None:
+    if connection.vendor != "postgresql":
+        pytest.skip("requires PostgreSQL row locks and pg_blocking_pids")
+
+    owner = _new_user("pg-owner-race")
+    replacement_owner = _new_user("pg-new-owner-race")
+    portfolio = _new_portfolio(owner, "pg-owner-race")
+    row = _new_transaction(portfolio)
+    before = _cost_state(row)
+    worker_pid_queue: Queue[int] = Queue()
+
+    def attempt_update() -> TransactionCostRecord | None:
+        """Run the real repository call with bounded lock and statement waits."""
+
+        close_old_connections()
+        worker_connection = connections["default"]
+        try:
+            with worker_connection.cursor() as cursor:
+                cursor.execute("SET lock_timeout = '6000ms'")
+                cursor.execute("SET statement_timeout = '9000ms'")
+                cursor.execute("SELECT pg_backend_pid()")
+                pid_row = cursor.fetchone()
+            assert pid_row is not None
+            worker_pid_queue.put(int(pid_row[0]))
+            return TransactionRepository().update_transaction_costs(
+                row.pk,
+                actor_user_id=owner.pk,
+                commission=Decimal("99"),
+            )
+        finally:
+            worker_connection.close()
+
+    with ThreadPoolExecutor(
+        max_workers=1,
+        thread_name_prefix="ash-fee-owner-race-repository-update",
+    ) as executor:
+        with transaction.atomic():
+            with connections["default"].cursor() as cursor:
+                cursor.execute("SELECT pg_backend_pid()")
+                main_pid_row = cursor.fetchone()
+            assert main_pid_row is not None
+            main_pid = int(main_pid_row[0])
+            locked_portfolio = PortfolioModel._default_manager.select_for_update().get(
+                pk=portfolio.pk
+            )
+            locked_portfolio.user_id = replacement_owner.pk
+            locked_portfolio.save(update_fields=["user"])
+
+            future = executor.submit(attempt_update)
+            worker_pid = worker_pid_queue.get(timeout=5)
+            assert worker_pid != main_pid
+            deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
+            blocker_pids: tuple[int, ...] = ()
+            while time.monotonic() < deadline and not future.done():
+                blocker_pids = _pg_blocking_pids(worker_pid)
+                if main_pid in blocker_pids:
+                    break
+                time.sleep(0.02)
+
+            assert main_pid in blocker_pids, (
+                "repository contender never appeared in pg_blocking_pids; "
+                f"last blockers were {blocker_pids}"
+            )
+
+        result = future.result(timeout=10)
+    assert result is None
+    assert PortfolioModel._default_manager.get(pk=portfolio.pk).user_id == replacement_owner.pk
+    assert _cost_state(TransactionModel._default_manager.get(pk=row.pk)) == before

+def _run_pg_repository_operation(
+    operation: Callable[[], object],
+    worker_pid_queue: Queue[int],
+) -> object:
+    """Run a real repository call on its own bounded PostgreSQL connection."""
+
+    close_old_connections()
+    worker_connection = connections["default"]
+    try:
+        with worker_connection.cursor() as cursor:
+            cursor.execute("SET lock_timeout = '6000ms'")
+            cursor.execute("SET statement_timeout = '9000ms'")
+            cursor.execute("SELECT pg_backend_pid()")
+            pid_row = cursor.fetchone()
+        assert pid_row is not None
+        worker_pid_queue.put(int(pid_row[0]))
+        return operation()
+    finally:
+        worker_connection.close()
+
+
+def _pg_main_backend_pid() -> int:
+    """Return the calling connection's real PostgreSQL backend PID."""
+
+    with connections["default"].cursor() as cursor:
+        cursor.execute("SELECT pg_backend_pid()")
+        pid_row = cursor.fetchone()
+    assert pid_row is not None
+    return int(pid_row[0])
+

+def _wait_for_pg_block_or_completion(
+    worker_pid: int,
+    main_pid: int,
+    future: Future[object],
+) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    """Wait for an observed blocker or completed repository call, with a bound."""
+
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
+    blocker_pids: tuple[int, ...] = ()
+    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+        blocker_pids = _pg_blocking_pids(worker_pid)
+        if main_pid in blocker_pids or future.done():
+            return blocker_pids
+        time.sleep(0.02)
+    return blocker_pids
+
+
+def _finish_pg_worker(
+    executor: ThreadPoolExecutor,
+    future: Future[object] | None,
+) -> None:
+    """Join the worker only after the surrounding main transaction has released locks."""
+
+    if future is not None:
+        try:
+            future.result(timeout=10)
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+    executor.shutdown(wait=True, cancel_futures=True)
+

+def _run_database_call(
+    function: Callable[_P, _R],
+    *args: _P.args,
+    **kwargs: _P.kwargs,
+) -> _R:
+    """Run one synchronous ORM helper on a dedicated worker thread."""
+
+    def invoke() -> _R:
+        try:
+            return function(*args, **kwargs)
+        finally:
+            connections.close_all()
+
+    with ThreadPoolExecutor(
+        max_workers=1,
+        thread_name_prefix="fee-admin-browser-db",
+    ) as executor:
+        return executor.submit(invoke).result()
+
+
+def _database_thread(function: Callable[_P, _R]) -> Callable[_P, _R]:
+    """Keep synchronous Django ORM helpers off Playwright's event-loop thread."""
+
+    @wraps(function)
+    def wrapped(*args: _P.args, **kwargs: _P.kwargs) -> _R:
+        return _run_database_call(function, *args, **kwargs)
+
+    return wrapped

+def _assert_local_requests(request_urls: list[str], base_url: str) -> None:
+    """Verify observed requests use only the exact isolated live-server origin."""
+
+    expected_origin = _network_origin(base_url)
+    assert expected_origin is not None
+    assert request_urls
+    assert all(_network_origin(url) == expected_origin for url in request_urls)
+
+
+def _network_origin(url: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
+    """Normalize network origins while preserving exact host and port."""
+
+    parsed = urlsplit(url)
+    scheme = parsed.scheme.lower()
+    if scheme == "ws":
+        scheme = "http"
+    elif scheme == "wss":
+        scheme = "https"
+    if not scheme or not parsed.netloc:
+        return None
+    return scheme, parsed.netloc.lower()
+
+
+def _guarded_context(
+    browser: Browser,
+    base_url: str,
+) -> tuple[BrowserContext, list[str]]:
+    """Create a context that routes only to the exact live-server origin."""
+
+    expected_origin = _network_origin(base_url)
+    assert expected_origin is not None
+    blocked_urls: list[str] = []
+    context = browser.new_context(
+        viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 900},
+        service_workers="block",
+    )
+
+    def route_http_request(route: Route) -> None:
+        """Continue real local requests and abort every other network request."""
+
+        request_url = route.request.url
+        if _network_origin(request_url) == expected_origin:
+            route.continue_()
+            return
+        blocked_urls.append(request_url)
+        route.abort("blockedbyclient")
+
+    def route_websocket(websocket: WebSocketRoute) -> None:
+        """Connect only same-origin WebSockets and close external attempts."""
+
+        if _network_origin(websocket.url) == expected_origin:
+            websocket.connect_to_server()
+            return
+        blocked_urls.append(websocket.url)
+        websocket.close(code=1008, reason="external network is disabled in this test")
+
+    context.route("**/*", route_http_request)
+    context.route_web_socket("**/*", route_websocket)
+    return context, blocked_urls
+
+
+def _assert_no_external_requests(blocked_urls: list[str]) -> None:
+    """Fail with the attempted URLs after the browser has blocked them."""
+
+    assert not blocked_urls, f"browser attempted external requests: {blocked_urls}"
+

+    def __init__(

"""Probe both owned local PG databases read-only, then test only the existing child."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
PREFIX = "fee-a-bbc7-root-4"
GRAPH_CODE = 'import os,runpy\nfrom urllib.parse import quote\nimport ash_domain_local_network_fence\nfrom django.conf import settings\ndb=settings.DATABASES[\'default\']\nassert db[\'TEST\'][\'NAME\']==\'test_ash_plan_binding_01a14268\'\nassert db[\'HOST\']==\'127.0.0.1\' and str(db[\'PORT\'])==\'52009\'\ndb[\'NAME\']=\'test_ash_plan_binding_01a14268\'\ndb.setdefault(\'OPTIONS\',{})[\'options\']=\'-c default_transaction_read_only=on -c statement_timeout=10000\'\nimport django\ndjango.setup()\nfrom django.db import connection\nassert connection.settings_dict[\'NAME\']==\'test_ash_plan_binding_01a14268\'\nos.environ[\'DATABASE_URL\']=\'postgresql://\'+quote(str(db[\'USER\']),safe=\'\')+\':\'+quote(str(db[\'PASSWORD\']),safe=\'\')+\'@127.0.0.1:52009/\'+db[\'NAME\']\nwith connection.cursor() as cursor:\n    cursor.execute("SELECT current_database(),current_setting(\'transaction_read_only\')")\n    assert cursor.fetchone()==(\'test_ash_plan_binding_01a14268\',\'on\')\nrunpy.run_path(\'scripts/check_migration_graph.py\',run_name=\'__main__\')\n'
CHILD = "test_ash_plan_binding_01a14268"
PARENT = "test_ash_quality_native"
INPUTS = [".tmp/ash_plan_binding_native_settings.py", ".tmp/ash_quality_native_postgres_settings.py",
    ".tmp/ash-quality-postgres.env", ".tmp/ash-native-postgres/runtime.json"]


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def probe(database: str, export: Path) -> dict:
    import psycopg
    private = export / ".tmp"
    values = dict(line.split("=", 1) for line in (private / "ash-quality-postgres.env").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line)
    runtime = json.loads((private / "ash-native-postgres/runtime.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert runtime["database"] == "ash_quality_native" and runtime["test_database"] == PARENT
    assert str(runtime["port"]) == "52009"
    assert database in {CHILD, PARENT}
    with psycopg.connect(host="127.0.0.1", port=52009, dbname=database, user=values["POSTGRES_USER"],
        password=values["POSTGRES_PASSWORD"], connect_timeout=5,
        options="-c default_transaction_read_only=on -c statement_timeout=10000") as connection:
        identity = connection.execute("SELECT current_database(),current_schema(),current_setting('server_version'),current_setting('server_version_num'),current_setting('transaction_isolation'),current_setting('transaction_read_only')").fetchone()
        assert identity[0] == database and identity[1] == "public" and identity[5] == "on"
        relations = connection.execute("SELECT relname,relkind FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') ORDER BY relname,relkind").fetchall()
        columns = connection.execute("SELECT table_name,column_name,ordinal_position,data_type,udt_name,is_nullable,column_default,numeric_precision,numeric_scale FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position").fetchall()
        constraints = connection.execute("SELECT c.relname,k.conname,k.contype,pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid,true) FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=k.conrelid WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace ORDER BY c.relname,k.conname").fetchall()
        migrations = connection.execute("SELECT app,name FROM django_migrations ORDER BY app,name").fetchall()
        generation = connection.execute("SELECT singleton,generation FROM account_authority_generation ORDER BY singleton").fetchall()
        assert len(generation) == 1 and generation[0][0] == 1
        active = connection.execute("SELECT application_name,state FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND pid<>pg_backend_pid() AND state<>'idle'").fetchall()
        assert not active, "Another active child/parent DB job must terminate before this phase"
    def fingerprint(value):
        return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, default=str, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()
    return {"database": database, "schema":"public", "server_version":identity[2],"server_version_num":int(identity[3]),
        "isolation":identity[4],"read_only_session":True,"migration_count":len(migrations),
        "migration_sha256":fingerprint(migrations),"schema_sha256":fingerprint([relations,columns,constraints]),
        "generation":generation,"has_0067":("account","0067_transaction_fee_availability_flags") in migrations,
        "active_other_sessions":active}


def main() -> None:
    import runpy
    helpers = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / ".tmp/run_fee_a_bbc7_root4_phase.py"))
    ref_path = ROOT / ".tmp" / f"{PREFIX}-reference.json"
    ref = json.loads(ref_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    export = Path(ref["export"])
    helpers["verify"](ref, export, outputs=True)
    out = ROOT / ".tmp" / f"{PREFIX}-native-result.json"
    log = ROOT / ".tmp" / f"{PREFIX}-native.log"
    assert not out.exists() and not log.exists()
    pins = {}
    for name in INPUTS:
        source = ROOT / name
        target = export / name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        if not target.exists():
            shutil.copy2(source,target)
        assert digest(source) == digest(target)
        pins[name] = digest(target)
    before = {database:probe(database,export) for database in (PARENT,CHILD)}
    assert before[PARENT]["migration_count"] == 544
    assert before[PARENT]["generation"] in ([[1,0]], [(1,0)])
    record = {"status":"native_preflight_observed_tests_not_run", "source_tree":ref["source_tree"], "source_commit":ref["source_commit"],
        "before":before, "private_input_raw_sha256":pins, "credentials_logged":False}
    out.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
    nodes = ref["native_required_nodes"]
    assert len(nodes) == 7 and len(set(nodes)) == 7
    junit = export / ".tmp" / f"{PREFIX}-native.xml"
    command = [str(ROOT / "agomtradepro/Scripts/python.exe"),"-X","utf8","-m","pytest",*nodes,
        "-q","--tb=short","--reuse-db","--migrations","--ds=ash_plan_binding_native_settings",
        "-p","ash_domain_local_network_fence", "-o","addopts=",f"--junitxml={junit}",
        f"--basetemp=.tmp/{PREFIX}-native-temp", "-o",f"cache_dir=.tmp/{PREFIX}-native-cache"]
    env = dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=os.pathsep.join([str(export),str(export/".tmp")]),
        DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE="ash_plan_binding_native_settings", PYTEST_ADDOPTS="", PYTHONUTF8="1",
        PYTHONIOENCODING="utf-8",GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0")
    print("native preflight complete; starting seven serial child-only tests",flush=True)
    start = time.monotonic()
    with log.open("wb") as stream:
        completed = subprocess.run(command,cwd=export,env=env,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    graph_log=ROOT/".tmp"/f"{PREFIX}-migration-graph.log"
    graph_command=[str(ROOT/"agomtradepro/Scripts/python.exe"),"-X","utf8","-c",GRAPH_CODE]
    graph_start=time.monotonic()
    with graph_log.open("wb") as stream:
        graph_completed=subprocess.run(graph_command,cwd=export,env=env,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    record["migration_graph"]={"exit_code":graph_completed.returncode,"seconds":round(time.monotonic()-graph_start,3),
        "log":str(graph_log),"log_raw_sha256":digest(graph_log),"read_only_child":True,
        "private_database_url_not_logged":True,"wrapper_raw_sha256":hashlib.sha256(GRAPH_CODE.encode()).hexdigest()}
    after = {database:probe(database,export) for database in (PARENT,CHILD)}
    assert before[PARENT] == after[PARENT], "Read-only parent metadata changed"
    assert after[CHILD]["has_0067"] is True
    cases = list(ET.parse(junit).iter("testcase")) if junit.exists() else []
    failures=sum(c.find("failure") is not None for c in cases)
    errors=sum(c.find("error") is not None for c in cases)
    skips=sum(c.find("skipped") is not None for c in cases)
    helpers["verify"](ref,export,outputs=True)
    assert all(digest(export/name)==pin and digest(ROOT/name)==pin for name,pin in pins.items())
    ok=completed.returncode==0 and graph_completed.returncode==0 and len(cases)==7 and not failures and not errors and not skips
    record.update(status="passed" if ok else "failed",after=after,parent_read_only_and_unchanged=True,
        command=command,exit_code=completed.returncode,seconds=round(time.monotonic()-start,3),
        counts={"total":len(cases),"passed":len(cases)-failures-errors-skips,"failed":failures,"errors":errors,"skipped":skips},
        actual_nodes=[c.attrib for c in cases],log_raw_sha256=digest(log),junit_raw_sha256=digest(junit) if junit.exists() else None,
        driver_raw_sha256=digest(Path(__file__)),reference_raw_sha256=digest(ref_path))
    out.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"status":record["status"],"exit_code":completed.returncode,"counts":record["counts"],"before":before,"after":after}),flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Retain the original native/coverage/RED checks in final Fee A admission."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET


def verify(root, ref):
    prefix="fee-a-bbc7-root-4"
    tmp=root/".tmp"
    export=Path(ref["export"])
    sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    load=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    artifacts={}
    native_path=tmp/f"{prefix}-native-result.json"
    native=load(native_path)
    assert native["status"]=="passed" and native["source_tree"]==ref["source_tree"]
    assert native["source_commit"]==ref["source_commit"]
    assert native["reference_raw_sha256"]==sha(tmp/f"{prefix}-reference.json")
    assert native["driver_raw_sha256"]==sha(tmp/"run_fee_a_native_root4.py")
    assert native["counts"]=={"total":7,"passed":7,"failed":0,"errors":0,"skipped":0}
    assert native["migration_graph"]["exit_code"]==0 and native["migration_graph"]["read_only_child"] is True
    assert native["migration_graph"]["private_database_url_not_logged"] is True
    assert native["parent_read_only_and_unchanged"] is True and native["credentials_logged"] is False
    assert native["before"]["test_ash_quality_native"]==native["after"]["test_ash_quality_native"]
    assert native["after"]["test_ash_plan_binding_01a14268"]["has_0067"] is True
    for snapshot in (native["before"],native["after"]):
        assert all(not row["active_other_sessions"] and row["read_only_session"] is True for row in snapshot.values())
    for name,pin in native["private_input_raw_sha256"].items():
        assert sha(root/name)==sha(export/name)==pin
    # Never add private settings/environment contents to the public evidence map.
    native_xml=export/".tmp"/f"{prefix}-native.xml"
    cases=list(ET.parse(native_xml).iter("testcase"))
    assert len(cases)==7 and all(all(c.find(t) is None for t in ("failure","error","skipped")) for c in cases)
    assert native["actual_nodes"]==[c.attrib for c in cases]
    expected={(node.split("::")[0].removesuffix(".py").replace("/","."),node.split("::")[-1]) for node in ref["native_required_nodes"]}
    assert {(c.attrib["classname"],c.attrib["name"]) for c in cases}==expected
    assert sha(native_xml)==native["junit_raw_sha256"]
    native_log=tmp/f"{prefix}-native.log"
    assert sha(native_log)==native["log_raw_sha256"]
    assert "Rejected application socket/DNS attempts: 0" in native_log.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    graph_log=Path(native["migration_graph"]["log"])
    assert graph_log.is_relative_to(tmp) and sha(graph_log)==native["migration_graph"]["log_raw_sha256"]
    for path in (native_path,native_xml,native_log,graph_log,tmp/"run_fee_a_native_root4.py"):
        artifacts[str(path.relative_to(root))]=sha(path)
    coverage_path=tmp/f"{prefix}-coverage-review.json"
    coverage=load(coverage_path)
    raw_path=export/".tmp/fee-a-coverage.json"
    raw=load(raw_path)
    assert coverage["status"]=="passed" and coverage["source_tree"]==ref["source_tree"]
    assert coverage["branches_have_no_invented_combined_floor"] is True
    floors={"domain":90,"application":80,"interface":70,"infrastructure":60}
    totals={name:[0,0,0,0] for name in floors}
    for path,record in raw["files"].items():
        name=path.replace("\\","/")
        if name.endswith("/__init__.py") or name.endswith("/migrations/0067_transaction_fee_availability_flags.py"):
            continue
        parts=name.split("/")
        layer=parts[2] if len(parts)>2 and parts[0]=="apps" else None
        if layer=="management":
            layer="infrastructure"
        if layer not in totals:
            continue
        summary=record["summary"]
        for i,key in enumerate(("covered_lines","num_statements","covered_branches","num_branches")):
            totals[layer][i]+=summary.get(key,0)
    assert set(coverage["layers"])==set(floors)
    for layer,floor in floors.items():
        row=coverage["layers"][layer]
        lines,statements,branches,branch_count=totals[layer]
        assert [row[k] for k in ("covered_lines","statements","covered_branches","branches")]==totals[layer]
        assert row["line_percent"]==100*lines/statements>=floor
        assert row["minimum_line_percent"]==floor and row["line_floor_passed"] is True
        assert row["branch_percent"]==(100*branches/branch_count if branch_count else None)
    main=load(tmp/f"{prefix}-main-result.json")["records"][0]
    assert any(n["name"].endswith("[infinity-pg-source]") for n in main["actual_nodes"])
    red_path=tmp/"fee-a-bbc7-root-red-1-test-result.json"
    assert sha(red_path)=="6a14b0da0a90e7c771ec7ccd36cd67a3b7111c4add123581c368bb8e2bf8f98a"
    for path in (coverage_path,raw_path,red_path,Path(__file__).resolve()):
        artifacts[str(path.relative_to(root))]=sha(path)
    return {"status":"passed","native_counts":native["counts"],"native_parent_unchanged":True,
            "native_schema_after":native["after"],"private_input_contents_omitted":True,
            "coverage_recomputed_from_raw":True,"artifacts_raw_sha256":artifacts}

"""Run database-dependent Fee A acceptance phases serially, stopping on failure."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import time

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
PREFIX="fee-a-bbc7-root-4"
PYTHON=ROOT/"agomtradepro/Scripts/python.exe"


def main():
    out=ROOT/".tmp"/f"{PREFIX}-db-sequence.json"
    assert not out.exists()
    commands=[
        ("main",[".tmp/run_fee_a_bbc7_root4_phase.py","main"]),
        ("migration",[".tmp/run_fee_a_bbc7_root4_phase.py","migration"]),
        ("native",[".tmp/run_fee_a_native_root4.py"]),
        ("browser",[".tmp/run_fee_a_bbc7_root4_phase.py","browser"]),
        ("api-edges",[".tmp/run_fee_a_bbc7_root4_phase.py","api-edges"]),
        ("domain",[".tmp/run_fee_a_root4_domain_with_junit.py","domain"]),
    ]
    records=[]
    for name,args in commands:
        print(f"starting serial database phase: {name}",flush=True)
        command=[str(PYTHON),"-X","utf8",*args]
        start=time.monotonic()
        result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,check=False)
        records.append({"phase":name,"command":command,"exit_code":result.returncode,

    data=json.loads(out.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    data["status"]="all_commands_terminal_review_required"

"""Run one bounded Fee A phase in Root's frozen export, recording real results."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
PREFIX = "fee-a-bbc7-root-4"
REF = ROOT / ".tmp" / f"{PREFIX}-reference.json"
PYTHON = ROOT / "agomtradepro/Scripts/python.exe"


def digest(path: Path, lf: bool = False) -> str:
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    return hashlib.sha256(raw.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n") if lf else raw).hexdigest()


def verify(ref: dict, export: Path, *, outputs: bool = False) -> None:
    assert digest(ROOT / ".git/index") == ref["main_index_raw_sha256"]
    head = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT,
        env=dict(os.environ, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0"), check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE).stdout.decode().strip()
    assert head == ref["base"]
    for name, pin in ref["protected_raw_sha256"].items():
        assert digest(ROOT / name) == pin, name
    for name, pin in ref["source_lf_sha256"].items():
        assert digest(ROOT / name, True) == pin and digest(export / name, True) == pin, name
    for key in ("all_python_lf_sha256", "runtime_lf_sha256", "settings_lf_sha256"):
        for name, pin in ref[key].items():
            assert digest(export / name, True) == pin, name
    copy = ref["protected_copy"]
    assert digest(export / copy["path"]) == copy["raw_sha256"]
    if outputs:
        review = json.loads((ROOT / ".tmp" / f"{PREFIX}-projection-review.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        assert review["strict_delta"] is True and review["source_tree"] == ref["source_tree"]
        for name, pin in review["output_lf_sha256"].items():
            assert digest(export / name, True) == pin


def main() -> None:
    assert len(sys.argv) == 2
    phase = sys.argv[1]
    assert phase in {"generate", "static", "main", "migration", "browser", "governance", "domain", "api-edges"}
    ref = json.loads(REF.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    export = Path(ref["export"])
    out = ROOT / ".tmp" / f"{PREFIX}-{phase}-result.json"
    logs = ROOT / ".tmp" / f"{PREFIX}-{phase}-logs"
    assert not out.exists() and not logs.exists()
    verify(ref, export, outputs=phase not in {"generate", "static"})
    logs.mkdir()
    catalog = json.loads((ROOT / ".tmp/ash-fee-atomic-a-command-catalog-v3-a11-20261018/command-catalog.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=os.pathsep.join([str(export), str(export / ".tmp")]),
        DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE="ash_formal_calendar_sqlite_settings", PYTHONUTF8="1", PYTHONIOENCODING="utf-8",
        PYTEST_ADDOPTS="", GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0", GIT_DIR=str(ROOT / ".git"),
        GIT_WORK_TREE=str(export), GIT_INDEX_FILE=str(ROOT / ".git/index"))
    production = ref["production"]
    style = production + ref["changed_tests"]
    commands: list[tuple[str, list[str], dict[str, str]]] = []
    pytest_common = ["-m", "pytest", "-q", "--tb=short", "--ds=ash_formal_calendar_sqlite_settings"]
    fence = ["-p", "ash_domain_local_network_fence"]
    if phase == "generate":
        launcher = "import ash_domain_local_network_fence,runpy,sys;sys.argv=sys.argv[1:];runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0],run_name='__main__')"
        commands = [
            ("matrix", ["-c", launcher, ".tmp/append_fee_inventory.py", "--root", str(export), "--output", str(export / ".tmp/fee-a-new-matrix.csv")], {}),
            ("schema", ["-c", launcher, "manage.py", "spectacular", "--file", "schema.yml"], {}),
            ("openapi-yaml", ["-c", launcher, "manage.py", "spectacular", "--file", "docs/testing/api/openapi.yaml"], {}),
            ("openapi-json", ["-c", launcher, "manage.py", "spectacular", "--format", "openapi-json", "--file", "docs/testing/api/openapi.json"], {}),
            ("module-map", ["scripts/build_module_map.py"], {}),
            ("dictionary", ["scripts/build_data_dictionary.py"], {}),
            ("dc-architecture", ["scripts/data_center_architecture_inventory.py", "--write"], {}),
            ("dc-entrypoints", ["scripts/data_center_entrypoint_inventory.py", "--write"], {}),
        ]
    elif phase == "static":
        commands = [
            ("black", ["-m", "black", "--check", "--workers", "1", *style], {}),
            ("isort", ["-m", "isort", "--check-only", *style], {}),
            ("ruff", ["-m", "ruff", "check", *style], {}),
            ("incremental-mypy", ["scripts/check_mypy_regression.py", *production], {"MYPY_CACHE_DIR": str(export / ".tmp/fee-a-incremental-mypy-cache")}),
            ("full-mypy-debt", ["scripts/check_mypy_debt_ceiling.py"], {"MYPY_CACHE_DIR": str(export / ".tmp/fee-a-full-mypy-cache")}),
        ]
    elif phase == "main":
        files = next(row for row in catalog["green"] if row["id"] == "main-sqlite-coverage")["files"]
        files += [
            "tests/unit/account/test_trading_cost_config.py",
            "tests/unit/test_account_macro_sizing.py",
            "tests/integration/account/test_volatility_reduction_contract.py",
            "tests/integration/account/test_stop_loss_execution_contract.py",
            "tests/integration/account/test_position_update_close_contract.py::TestPositionCloseWritesTransaction::test_repository_close_uses_execution_price_and_reason",
            "tests/integration/account/test_ledger_unification_acceptance.py::test_migration_rejects_invalid_user_scope",
            "tests/integration/account/test_ledger_unification_acceptance.py::test_migration_two_portfolios_create_two_independent_accounts",
            "tests/integration/account/test_ledger_unification_acceptance.py::test_migration_non_integer_shares_preserved",
            "tests/integration/account/test_ledger_unification_acceptance.py::test_migration_idempotent",
        ]
        args = [*pytest_common, "--no-migrations", *fence, *files,
            *[f"--deselect={n}" for n in ref["required_sqlite_exact_deselections"]], "--cov-branch"]
        args.extend(f"--cov={module}" for module in [*catalog["coverage"]["modules"], "apps.account.infrastructure.transaction_record_repository"])
        args.extend(["--cov-report=json:.tmp/fee-a-coverage.json", "--cov-report=term-missing", "--cov-fail-under=0"])
        commands = [("suite", args, {"COVERAGE_FILE": str(export / ".tmp/fee-a-main.coverage")})]
    elif phase == "migration":
        commands = [("0067", [*pytest_common, *fence, "--migrations", "--create-db",
            "tests/component/account/test_transaction_fee_availability_migration.py"], {})]
    elif phase == "browser":
        commands = [("admin", [*pytest_common, "--no-migrations", "--create-db",
            "tests/component/account/test_transaction_fee_admin_browser_journey.py"], {})]
    elif phase == "api-edges":
        commands = [("transaction", [*pytest_common, *fence, "--no-migrations",
            "tests/api/test_account_api_edges.py", "-k", "transaction"], {})]
    elif phase == "domain":
        commands = [("line-gate", ["scripts/run_incremental_domain_coverage.py", "apps.account.domain", "--max-workers", "1"],
            {"PYTEST_ADDOPTS": "-p ash_domain_local_network_fence --ds=ash_formal_calendar_sqlite_settings --no-migrations"})]
    elif phase == "governance":
        for row in catalog["static"]["checks"]:
            label, _, _, _, *args = row
            if label == "migration graph":
                continue  # Run after real child DB migrations in the native phase.
            args = [arg.replace("<actual-base>", ref["base"]).replace("<frozen-source-commit>", ref["source_commit"]) for arg in args]
            commands.append((label.replace(" ", "-"), args, {}))
    records = []
    for label, args, extra in commands:
        junit = export / ".tmp" / f"{PREFIX}-{phase}-{label}.xml"
        is_pytest = args[:2] == ["-m", "pytest"]
        if is_pytest:
            args += [f"--junitxml={junit}", f"--basetemp=.tmp/{PREFIX}-{phase}-{label}-temp", "-o", f"cache_dir=.tmp/{PREFIX}-{phase}-cache"]
        command = [str(PYTHON), "-X", "utf8", *args]
        log = logs / f"{label}.log"
        print(f"starting {phase}/{label}", flush=True)
        start = time.monotonic()
        with log.open("wb") as stream:
            completed = subprocess.run(command, cwd=export, env=dict(env, **extra), stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        item = {"label": label, "command": command, "exit_code": completed.returncode,
            "seconds": round(time.monotonic()-start, 3), "log": str(log), "log_raw_sha256": digest(log)}
        if is_pytest and junit.is_file():
            cases = list(ET.parse(junit).iter("testcase"))
            failed = sum(c.find("failure") is not None for c in cases)
            errors = sum(c.find("error") is not None for c in cases)
            skipped = sum(c.find("skipped") is not None for c in cases)
            item.update(junit=str(junit), junit_raw_sha256=digest(junit), counts={"total":len(cases),
                "passed":len(cases)-failed-errors-skipped,"failed":failed,"errors":errors,"skipped":skipped},
                actual_nodes=[c.attrib for c in cases])
            matches = re.findall(r"(\d+) deselected", log.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"))
            item["deselected"] = int(matches[-1]) if matches else 0
        if phase == "generate" and label == "matrix" and completed.returncode == 0:
            import csv
            target = export / "docs/plans/web-to-tui-migration-matrix-2026-07-25.csv"
            candidate = export / ".tmp/fee-a-new-matrix.csv"
            def csv_rows(path):
                with path.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
                    return list(csv.DictReader(handle))
            before = csv_rows(target)
            after = csv_rows(candidate)
            assert len(before) == 196 and len(after) == 197 and after[:-1] == before
            assert after[-1]["template_path"] == "core/templates/admin/account/transaction/correct_costs.html"
            target.write_bytes(candidate.read_bytes())
            item["all_196_prior_rows_and_fields_retained"] = True
        records.append(item)
        out.write_text(json.dumps({"phase": phase, "status":"running", "base":ref["base"],
            "source_tree":ref["source_tree"],"source_commit":ref["source_commit"], "records":records}, indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
        print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in item.items() if k in {"label","exit_code","seconds","counts","deselected"}}),flush=True)
    verify(ref, export, outputs=phase not in {"generate", "static"})
    report = json.loads(out.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    report.update(status="commands_finished_review_required", driver_raw_sha256=digest(Path(__file__)), reference_raw_sha256=digest(REF))
    out.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
    raise SystemExit(0 if all(r["exit_code"] == 0 for r in records) else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def sha256_path(path: Path) -> str:
    """Return the raw SHA-256 of a file without normalizing its bytes."""
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def git_blob_oid(raw: bytes) -> str:
    """Compute a Git blob object ID with the repository's SHA-1 object format."""
    header = f"blob {len(raw)}\0".encode("ascii")
    import hashlib as _hashlib

    return _hashlib.sha1(header + raw).hexdigest()


def require_export_git_blob(root: Path, export: Path, commit: str, name: str, oid: str) -> None:
    """Bind exact Git object bytes and permit only recorded export newline conversion."""
    blob = subprocess.run(["git", "cat-file", "blob", f"{commit}:{name}"],
        cwd=root, env=dict(os.environ, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0"), check=True,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE).stdout
    _require(git_blob_oid(blob) == oid, f"Git object ID mismatch: {name}")
    exported = (export / Path(*PurePosixPath(name).parts)).read_bytes()
    _require(blob.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n") == exported.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n"),
             f"Export differs from Git object beyond line endings: {name}")


def load_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Read one UTF-8 JSON object."""
    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise AssertionError(f"expected JSON object: {path}")
    return value


def _require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(message)


def validate_root5_focused_result(
    *, root: Path, root5_ref: dict[str, Any], root5_ref_path: Path,
    proof_path: Path, report_path: Path, expected_report_sha256: str,
    root5_driver_path: Path, expected_driver_sha256: str,
    report: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Validate final Root6 focused checks; prior Root4/Root5 runs remain separate."""
    _require(sha256_path(report_path) == expected_report_sha256, "Root6 focused report pin mismatch")
    _require(sha256_path(root5_driver_path) == expected_driver_sha256, "Root6 focused driver pin mismatch")
    _require(report.get("schema_version") == "fee_a_root5_focused_acceptance.v1", "unknown Root6 focused report schema")
    _require(report.get("final_revision_label") == "Root6", "focused report is not labeled Root6")
    _require(report.get("status") == "passed", "Root6 focused acceptance is not green")
    _require(report.get("base") == root5_ref["base"], "Root6 focused report base mismatch")
    _require(report.get("source_tree") == root5_ref["source_tree"], "Root6 focused report tree mismatch")
    _require(report.get("source_commit") == root5_ref["source_commit"], "Root6 focused report commit mismatch")
    _require(report.get("reference_raw_sha256") == sha256_path(root5_ref_path), "Root6 focused report ref pin mismatch")
    _require(report.get("revision_proof_raw_sha256") == sha256_path(proof_path), "Root6 focused report proof pin mismatch")
    _require(report.get("driver_raw_sha256") == expected_driver_sha256, "Root6 focused report driver pin mismatch")
    records = report.get("records", [])
    _require(len(records) == 7, "Root6 focused report must contain 3 style, 1 browser, 1 API, and 2 projection checks")
    expected = {
        ("style", "black"), ("style", "isort"), ("style", "ruff"),
        ("browser", "admin"), ("api-edges", "transaction"),
        ("projection", "dc-architecture"), ("projection", "dc-entrypoints"),
    }
    observed = {(row.get("phase"), row.get("label")) for row in records}
    _require(observed == expected and len(observed) == len(records), "Root6 focused record set is incomplete or duplicated")
    style_paths = {ROOT4_BROWSER, ROOT5_API_EDGE}
    artifacts: dict[str, str] = {str(report_path.relative_to(root)): expected_report_sha256,
                                 str(root5_driver_path.relative_to(root)): expected_driver_sha256}
    for row in records:
        _require(row.get("exit_code") == 0, f"Root6 {row.get('phase')}/{row.get('label')} failed")
        command = row.get("command", [])
        if row["phase"] == "style":
            _require(style_paths.issubset(set(command)), f"Root6 style command does not cover both changed Python paths: {row['label']}")
        elif row["phase"] == "browser":
            _require(ROOT4_BROWSER in command, "Root6 browser command omitted the changed browser test")
            _require(row.get("deselected") == 0, "Root6 browser test selection changed")
        elif row["phase"] == "api-edges":
            _require(ROOT5_API_EDGE in command and "-k" in command and "transaction" in command,
                     "Root6 API-edge command did not select transaction cases")
            _require(row.get("deselected") == 59, "Root6 API-edge selection changed")

        _require(sha256_path(log) == row.get("log_raw_sha256"), "Root6 focused log pin mismatch")
        artifacts[str(log.relative_to(root))] = row["log_raw_sha256"]
        if row.get("junit"):
            junit = Path(row["junit"])
            _require(junit.is_relative_to(root / ".tmp"), "Root6 JUnit escaped ignored evidence directory")
            _require(sha256_path(junit) == row.get("junit_raw_sha256"), "Root6 JUnit pin mismatch")
            cases = list(ET.parse(junit).iter("testcase"))
            counts = {"total": len(cases),
                      "failed": sum(case.find("failure") is not None for case in cases),
                      "errors": sum(case.find("error") is not None for case in cases),
                      "skipped": sum(case.find("skipped") is not None for case in cases)}
            counts["passed"] = counts["total"] - counts["failed"] - counts["errors"] - counts["skipped"]
            _require(counts == row.get("counts"), "Root6 reported test counts differ from JUnit")
            expected_counts = {"browser": {"total": 3, "passed": 3, "failed": 0, "errors": 0, "skipped": 0},
                               "api-edges": {"total": 9, "passed": 9, "failed": 0, "errors": 0, "skipped": 0}}
            _require(counts == expected_counts[row["phase"]],
                     f"Root6 {row['phase']} tests must pass at the exact expected count without skips")
            if row["phase"] in {"browser", "api-edges"}:
                _require(row.get("actual_nodes") == [case.attrib for case in cases],
                         f"Root6 {row['phase']} actual node record differs from JUnit")
            artifacts[str(junit.relative_to(root))] = row["junit_raw_sha256"]
        elif row["phase"] in {"browser", "api-edges"}:
            raise AssertionError(f"Root6 {row['phase']} record lacks JUnit evidence")
    return {"status": "passed", "final_revision_label": "Root6",
            "final_tree": root5_ref["source_tree"], "final_commit": root5_ref["source_commit"],

def validate_root5_intermediate_failure(
    *, root: Path, final_ref: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Preserve the failed intermediate Root5 browser run without treating it as green."""
    prefix = "fee-a-bbc7-root-5"
    reference_path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-reference.json"
    proof_path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-revision-proof.json"
    report_path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-focused-result.json"
    driver_path = root / ".tmp" / "run_fee_a_root5_focused.py"
    _require(sha256_path(reference_path) == ROOT5_INTERMEDIATE_REFERENCE_SHA256,
             "intermediate Root5 reference raw pin mismatch")
    _require(sha256_path(proof_path) == ROOT5_INTERMEDIATE_PROOF_SHA256,
             "intermediate Root5 proof raw pin mismatch")
    _require(sha256_path(report_path) == ROOT5_INTERMEDIATE_FOCUSED_SHA256,
             "intermediate Root5 failed report raw pin mismatch")
    _require(sha256_path(driver_path) == ROOT5_INTERMEDIATE_DRIVER_SHA256,
             "intermediate Root5 focused driver raw pin mismatch")
    _require(final_ref.get("final_revision_label") == "Root6", "final reference lacks Root6 label")
    _require(final_ref.get("intermediate_root5_reference_raw_sha256") == sha256_path(reference_path),
             "Root6 reference does not bind the intermediate Root5 reference")
    _require(final_ref.get("intermediate_root5_focused_failure_raw_sha256") == sha256_path(report_path),
             "Root6 reference does not bind the failed Root5 report")
    _require(final_ref.get("intermediate_root5_delta_paths") == [ROOT4_BROWSER],
             "Root6 reference must record only the browser path changed since Root5")
    root5_ref = load_json(reference_path)
    root5_proof = load_json(proof_path)
    report = load_json(report_path)
    _require(report.get("schema_version") == "fee_a_root5_focused_acceptance.v1"
             and report.get("status") == "failed", "Root5 failed report was changed or relabeled")
    _require(report.get("base") == root5_ref.get("base") == final_ref.get("base")
             and report.get("source_tree") == root5_ref.get("source_tree")
             and report.get("source_commit") == root5_ref.get("source_commit"),
             "Root5 failed report source identity mismatch")
    _require(root5_ref.get("source_tree") != final_ref.get("source_tree")
             and root5_ref.get("source_commit") != final_ref.get("source_commit"),
             "Root5 intermediate run must remain distinct from Root6")
    _require(report.get("reference_raw_sha256") == sha256_path(reference_path)
             and report.get("revision_proof_raw_sha256") == sha256_path(proof_path)
             and report.get("driver_raw_sha256") == sha256_path(driver_path),
             "Root5 report reference/proof/driver bindings mismatch")
    _require(root5_proof.get("root5_source_tree") == root5_ref.get("source_tree"),
             "Root5 intermediate proof source tree mismatch")
    records = report.get("records", [])
    _require([(row.get("phase"), row.get("label"), row.get("exit_code")) for row in records]
             == [("style", "black", 0), ("style", "isort", 0), ("style", "ruff", 0),
                 ("browser", "admin", 1)], "Root5 failed phase record history changed")
    artifacts = {str(path.relative_to(root)): sha256_path(path)
                 for path in (reference_path, proof_path, report_path, driver_path)}
    browser = records[-1]
    _require(ROOT4_BROWSER in browser.get("command", []) and browser.get("deselected") == 0,
             "Root5 failed run did not execute the exact browser test selection")
    log = Path(browser["log"])
    junit = Path(browser["junit"])
    _require(log.is_relative_to(root / ".tmp")
             and junit.resolve().is_relative_to(Path(root5_ref["export"]).resolve() / ".tmp"),
             "Root5 failure log/JUnit escaped ignored evidence")
    _require(sha256_path(log) == browser.get("log_raw_sha256")
             and sha256_path(junit) == browser.get("junit_raw_sha256"),
             "Root5 failure log/JUnit pin mismatch")
    cases = list(ET.parse(junit).iter("testcase"))
    counts = {"total": len(cases),
              "failed": sum(case.find("failure") is not None for case in cases),
              "errors": sum(case.find("error") is not None for case in cases),
              "skipped": sum(case.find("skipped") is not None for case in cases)}
    counts["passed"] = counts["total"] - counts["failed"] - counts["errors"] - counts["skipped"]
    _require(counts == browser.get("counts")
             == {"total": 3, "passed": 2, "failed": 1, "errors": 0, "skipped": 0},
             "Root5 failed browser counts changed")
    _require(browser.get("actual_nodes") == [case.attrib for case in cases],
             "Root5 browser actual nodes differ from JUnit")
    failed = [case for case in cases if case.find("failure") is not None or case.find("error") is not None]
    _require(len(failed) == 1 and failed[0].attrib.get("name")
             == "test_browser_csrf_and_foreign_owner_denials_leave_the_ledger_unchanged",

    artifacts[str(log.relative_to(root))] = sha256_path(log)
    artifacts[str(junit.relative_to(root))] = sha256_path(junit)
    return {"status": "failed_retained_history", "source_tree": root5_ref["source_tree"],
            "source_commit": root5_ref["source_commit"], "counts": counts,
