def validate_root5_revision(
    *, root: Path, root4_ref: dict[str, Any], root5_ref: dict[str, Any],
    proof: dict[str, Any], root4_ref_path: Path, root5_ref_path: Path,
    proof_path: Path, root4_projection_review_path: Path,
    final_projection_review_path: Path, expected_root5_ref_sha256: str,
    expected_proof_sha256: str, expected_final_projection_review_sha256: str,
    root4_projection_review: dict[str, Any], final_projection_review: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Bind final Root6 to Root4 regression while retaining Root5 as failed history."""
    _require(sha256_path(root5_ref_path) == expected_root5_ref_sha256, "Root6 reference pin mismatch")
    _require(sha256_path(proof_path) == expected_proof_sha256, "Root6 revision proof pin mismatch")
    _require(sha256_path(final_projection_review_path) == expected_final_projection_review_sha256,
             "Root6 projection-review raw pin mismatch")
    _require(sha256_path(root4_ref_path) == ROOT4_REFERENCE_SHA256, "Root4 reference pin mismatch")
    _require(sha256_path(root4_projection_review_path) == ROOT4_PROJECTION_REVIEW_SHA256,
             "Root4 projection-review pin mismatch")
    _require(root4_ref["base"] == root5_ref["base"], "Root4/Root6 base differs")
    _require(root5_ref.get("final_revision_label") == "Root6", "reference does not identify final Root6")
    _require(root5_ref["source_tree"] == ROOT6_SOURCE_TREE, "Root6 source tree differs from frozen pin")
    _require(root5_ref["source_commit"] == ROOT6_SOURCE_COMMIT, "Root6 source commit differs from frozen pin")
    _require(root4_ref["source_tree"] != root5_ref["source_tree"]
             and root4_ref["source_commit"] != root5_ref["source_commit"],
             "Root6 must remain a distinct frozen source tree")
    _require(root4_ref["production"] == root5_ref["production"] and len(root4_ref["production"]) == 18,
             "production path list/count changed")

    root4_paths, final_paths = set(root4_ref["owned_paths"]), set(root5_ref["owned_paths"])
    _require(final_paths - root4_paths == {ROOT5_API_EDGE} and root4_paths - final_paths == set(),
             "Root6 source ownership delta differs from the one added API-edge test")
    _require(len(root4_paths) == 34 and len(final_paths) == 35, "unexpected Root4/Root6 owned path counts")
    _require(root4_ref["official_outputs"] == root5_ref["official_outputs"]
             and len(root5_ref["official_outputs"]) == 9, "official projection whitelist changed")

    root4_lf, final_lf = root4_ref["source_lf_sha256"], root5_ref["source_lf_sha256"]
    _require(set(root4_lf) == root4_paths and set(final_lf) == final_paths,
             "Root4/Root6 LF source pin coverage changed")
    changed_lf = {path for path in root4_paths | final_paths if root4_lf.get(path) != final_lf.get(path)}
    _require(changed_lf == ROOT5_CHANGED_PATHS, "Root4→Root6 content delta exceeds the three approved paths")
    _require(proof.get("schema_version") == "fee_a_root5_test_only_revision.v1"
             and proof.get("final_revision_label") == "Root6", "unknown/unlabeled Root6 revision proof")
    _require(proof.get("root4_reference_raw_sha256") == sha256_path(root4_ref_path)
             and proof.get("root5_reference_raw_sha256") == expected_root5_ref_sha256,
             "revision proof reference bindings mismatch")
    _require(proof.get("root4_source_tree") == root4_ref["source_tree"]
             and proof.get("root5_source_tree") == root5_ref["source_tree"],
             "revision proof Root4/Root6 tree identity mismatch")
    _require(set(proof.get("changed_paths", [])) == ROOT5_CHANGED_PATHS,
             "revision proof does not name the exact three Root4→Root6 paths")

    root4_blobs, final_blobs = proof.get("root4_git_blob_oids", {}), proof.get("root5_git_blob_oids", {})
    _require(set(root4_blobs) == root4_paths and set(final_blobs) == final_paths,
             "Root4/Root6 Git blob proof coverage is incomplete")
    changed_blobs = {path for path in root4_paths | final_paths if root4_blobs.get(path) != final_blobs.get(path)}
    _require(changed_blobs == ROOT5_CHANGED_PATHS, "Root4→Root6 Git blob delta differs from approved paths")
    root4_export, final_export = Path(root4_ref["export"]), Path(root5_ref["export"])
    for path in root4_paths:
        raw = (root4_export / Path(*PurePosixPath(path).parts)).read_bytes()
        _require(hashlib.sha256(raw.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest() == root4_lf[path],
                 f"Root4 export LF source pin mismatch: {path}")
        require_export_git_blob(root, root4_export, root4_ref["source_commit"], path, root4_blobs[path])
    for path in final_paths:
        raw = (final_export / Path(*PurePosixPath(path).parts)).read_bytes()
        _require(hashlib.sha256(raw.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest() == final_lf[path],
                 f"Root6 export LF source pin mismatch: {path}")
        require_export_git_blob(root, final_export, root5_ref["source_commit"], path, final_blobs[path])
        live = root / Path(*PurePosixPath(path).parts)
        _require(live.is_file(), f"Root6 live source is missing: {path}")
        _require(hashlib.sha256(live.read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest() == final_lf[path],
                 f"Root6 live source LF differs from frozen export: {path}")

    intermediate_ref_path = root / ".tmp" / "fee-a-bbc7-root-5-reference.json"
    intermediate_proof_path = root / ".tmp" / "fee-a-bbc7-root-5-revision-proof.json"
    _require(sha256_path(intermediate_ref_path) == ROOT5_INTERMEDIATE_REFERENCE_SHA256
             and sha256_path(intermediate_proof_path) == ROOT5_INTERMEDIATE_PROOF_SHA256,
             "intermediate Root5 source lineage pins mismatch")
    intermediate_ref, intermediate_proof = load_json(intermediate_ref_path), load_json(intermediate_proof_path)
    _require(root5_ref.get("prior_source_tree") == root4_ref.get("source_tree")
             and root5_ref.get("prior_source_commit") == root4_ref.get("source_commit")
             and root5_ref.get("prior_reference_raw_sha256") == sha256_path(root4_ref_path),
             "Root6 frozen reference does not bind its Root4 source preimage")
    _require(set(root5_ref.get("only_changed_vs_prior", [])) == ROOT5_CHANGED_PATHS
             and proof.get("root5_only_selector_literal_ast_change") is True,
             "Root4→Root6 delta or Root5→Root6 selector proof changed")
    intermediate_blobs = intermediate_proof.get("root5_git_blob_oids", {})
    _require(set(intermediate_blobs) == final_paths, "intermediate Root5 Git blob proof is incomplete")
    _require({path for path in final_paths if intermediate_blobs.get(path) != final_blobs.get(path)} == {ROOT4_BROWSER},
             "Root5→Root6 blob delta exceeds the browser selector path")

    _require(proof.get("root4_official_output_blob_oids") == proof.get("root5_official_output_blob_oids")
             and set(proof.get("root5_official_output_blob_oids", {})) == set(root5_ref["official_outputs"]),
             "Root6 official projection blob proof is incomplete or changed")
    _require(root4_projection_review.get("strict_delta") is True
             and set(root4_projection_review.get("output_lf_sha256", {})) == set(root5_ref["official_outputs"]),
             "Root4 projection review is not strict or does not match the nine-output whitelist")
    _require(proof.get("root5_official_output_lf_sha256") == root4_projection_review["output_lf_sha256"],
             "Root6 official output LF pins differ from approved Root4 outputs")
    for path, pin in root4_projection_review["output_lf_sha256"].items():
        old_raw = (root4_export / Path(*PurePosixPath(path).parts)).read_bytes()
        new_raw = (final_export / Path(*PurePosixPath(path).parts)).read_bytes()
        _require(hashlib.sha256(old_raw.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest() == pin
                 and hashlib.sha256(new_raw.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest() == pin,
                 f"Root4/Root6 official output LF pin mismatch: {path}")
        _require(git_blob_oid(old_raw) == proof["root4_official_output_blob_oids"][path]
                 and git_blob_oid(new_raw) == proof["root5_official_output_blob_oids"][path],
                 f"Root4/Root6 official output blob mismatch: {path}")
    _require(final_projection_review.get("strict_delta") is True
             and final_projection_review.get("source_tree") == root5_ref["source_tree"]
             and final_projection_review.get("source_commit") == root5_ref["source_commit"]
             and final_projection_review.get("revision_proof_raw_sha256") == expected_proof_sha256,
             "Root6 focused projection review identity/proof mismatch")
    _require(final_projection_review.get("origin_projection_review_raw_sha256") == ROOT4_PROJECTION_REVIEW_SHA256
             and final_projection_review.get("output_lf_sha256") == root4_projection_review["output_lf_sha256"],
             "Root6 focused projection review differs from approved Root4 outputs")
    return {
        "final_revision_label": "Root6",
        "root4": {"base": root4_ref["base"], "source_commit": root4_ref["source_commit"],
                  "source_tree": root4_ref["source_tree"], "reference_raw_sha256": sha256_path(root4_ref_path)},
        "root5": {"base": root5_ref["base"], "source_commit": root5_ref["source_commit"],
                  "source_tree": root5_ref["source_tree"], "reference_raw_sha256": expected_root5_ref_sha256},
        "intermediate_root5": {"base": intermediate_ref["base"],
                                "source_commit": intermediate_ref["source_commit"],
                                "source_tree": intermediate_ref["source_tree"],
                                "reference_raw_sha256": sha256_path(intermediate_ref_path)},
        "revision_proof_raw_sha256": expected_proof_sha256,
        "changed_paths": sorted(ROOT5_CHANGED_PATHS),
        "official_outputs": sorted(root5_ref["official_outputs"]),
        "official_output_lf_sha256": root4_projection_review["output_lf_sha256"],
        "official_outputs_unchanged": True,
    }


def validate_root4_green_subset(*, root: Path, prefix: str, root4_ref: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Validate Root4 phases that passed; browser/API failures are checked separately."""
    expected_labels = {
        "generate": {"matrix", "schema", "openapi-yaml", "openapi-json", "module-map", "dictionary",
                     "dc-architecture", "dc-entrypoints"},
        "static": {"black", "isort", "ruff", "incremental-mypy", "full-mypy-debt"},
        "governance": {"architecture", "module-cycles", "changed-size", "inventory-check", "module-map",
                       "data-dictionary", "data-center-projections", "current-contracts", "audit-contracts",
                       "celery-contracts", "full-governance", "versioned-retirement"},
        "main": {"suite"}, "migration": {"0067"},
    }
    artifacts: dict[str, str] = {}
    summaries: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
    for phase, labels in expected_labels.items():
        path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-{phase}-result.json"
        data = load_json(path)
        _require(data.get("status") == "commands_finished_review_required", f"Root4 {phase} report status mismatch")
        _require(data.get("base") == root4_ref["base"] and data.get("source_commit") == root4_ref["source_commit"]
                 and data.get("source_tree") == root4_ref["source_tree"], f"Root4 {phase} source identity mismatch")
        _require(data.get("driver_raw_sha256") == ROOT4_PHASE_DRIVER_SHA256, f"Root4 {phase} phase-driver pin mismatch")
        _require(data.get("reference_raw_sha256") == ROOT4_REFERENCE_SHA256,
                 f"Root4 {phase} reference raw pin mismatch")
        _require({row.get("label") for row in data.get("records", [])} == labels, f"Root4 {phase} labels changed")
        _require(len(data["records"]) == len(labels), f"Root4 {phase} has duplicate/missing labels")
        artifacts[str(path.relative_to(root))] = sha256_path(path)
        for row in data["records"]:
            _require(row.get("exit_code") == 0, f"Root4 {phase}/{row.get('label')} was not green")
            log = Path(row["log"])
            _require(log.is_relative_to(root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-{phase}-logs"), f"Root4 {phase} log path escaped")
            _require(sha256_path(log) == row.get("log_raw_sha256"), f"Root4 {phase} log pin mismatch")
            artifacts[str(log.relative_to(root))] = row["log_raw_sha256"]
            if row.get("junit"):
                junit = Path(row["junit"])
                _require(junit.is_relative_to(Path(root4_ref["export"]) / ".tmp"), f"Root4 {phase} JUnit escaped export")
                _require(sha256_path(junit) == row.get("junit_raw_sha256"), f"Root4 {phase} JUnit pin mismatch")
                cases = list(ET.parse(junit).iter("testcase"))
                counts = {"total": len(cases),
                          "failed": sum(case.find("failure") is not None for case in cases),
                          "errors": sum(case.find("error") is not None for case in cases),
                          "skipped": sum(case.find("skipped") is not None for case in cases)}
                counts["passed"] = counts["total"] - counts["failed"] - counts["errors"] - counts["skipped"]
                _require(counts == row.get("counts") and counts["failed"] == counts["errors"] == counts["skipped"] == 0,
                         f"Root4 {phase} JUnit counts mismatch")
                _require([case.attrib for case in cases] == row.get("actual_nodes"), f"Root4 {phase} JUnit node mismatch")
                if phase == "main":
                    _require(counts["passed"] == 432 and row.get("deselected") == 7, "Root4 main suite count mismatch")
                if phase == "migration":
                    _require(counts["passed"] == 1, "Root4 migration count mismatch")
                summaries[phase] = counts
                artifacts[str(junit.relative_to(root))] = row["junit_raw_sha256"]
            elif phase in {"main", "migration"}:
                raise AssertionError(f"Root4 {phase} successful pytest phase lacks JUnit evidence")
    native_path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-native-result.json"
    native = load_json(native_path)
    _require(native.get("status") == "passed" and native.get("source_tree") == root4_ref["source_tree"]
             and native.get("source_commit") == root4_ref["source_commit"], "Root4 native identity/status mismatch")
    native_driver = root / ".tmp" / "run_fee_a_native_root4.py"
    _require(sha256_path(native_driver) == ROOT4_NATIVE_DRIVER_SHA256
             and native.get("driver_raw_sha256") == ROOT4_NATIVE_DRIVER_SHA256, "Root4 native driver pin mismatch")
    _require(native.get("counts") == {"total": 7, "passed": 7, "failed": 0, "errors": 0, "skipped": 0},
             "Root4 native test counts mismatch")
    _require(native.get("parent_read_only_and_unchanged") is True, "Root4 native parent safety flag mismatch")
    artifacts[str(native_path.relative_to(root))] = sha256_path(native_path)
    artifacts[str(native_driver.relative_to(root))] = ROOT4_NATIVE_DRIVER_SHA256
    coverage_path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-coverage-review.json"
    coverage = load_json(coverage_path)
    _require(coverage.get("status") == "passed" and coverage.get("source_tree") == root4_ref["source_tree"],
             "Root4 coverage-review identity/status mismatch")
    _require(bool(coverage.get("layers")) and all(row.get("line_floor_passed") is True
                                                   for row in coverage["layers"].values()),
             "Root4 coverage floor evidence is incomplete")
    artifacts[str(coverage_path.relative_to(root))] = sha256_path(coverage_path)
    return {"root4_green_phases": summaries, "root4_native_counts": native["counts"],
            "root4_coverage_layers": coverage["layers"], "artifacts_raw_sha256": artifacts}


def validate_root4_failed_history(
    *, root: Path, prefix: str, sequence: dict[str, Any],
    root4_ref: dict[str, Any],
    sequence_driver: Path, root4_browser_result: dict[str, Any],
    remaining: dict[str, Any], remaining_driver: Path,
    root4_api_edge_result: dict[str, Any], phase_driver: Path,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Keep Root4 browser/API-edge failures as historical non-green evidence."""
    sequence_path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-db-sequence.json"
    browser_result_path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-browser-result.json"
    api_result_path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-api-edges-result.json"
    remaining_path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-remaining-checks.json"
    _require(sha256_path(sequence_path) == ROOT4_SEQUENCE_RESULT_SHA256, "Root4 sequence report raw pin mismatch")
    _require(sha256_path(browser_result_path) == ROOT4_BROWSER_RESULT_SHA256, "Root4 browser report raw pin mismatch")
    _require(sha256_path(api_result_path) == ROOT4_API_RESULT_SHA256, "Root4 API-edge report raw pin mismatch")
    _require(sha256_path(remaining_path) == ROOT4_REMAINING_RESULT_SHA256, "Root4 continuation report raw pin mismatch")
    _require(load_json(sequence_path) == sequence and load_json(browser_result_path) == root4_browser_result
             and load_json(api_result_path) == root4_api_edge_result and load_json(remaining_path) == remaining,
             "Root4 failure inputs differ from the pinned history artifacts")
    _require(sequence.get("status") == "stopped_on_failure", "Root4 DB sequence must retain its stopped status")
    _require(sha256_path(sequence_driver) == ROOT4_SEQUENCE_DRIVER_SHA256, "Root4 sequence driver changed")
    _require(sequence.get("driver_raw_sha256") == ROOT4_SEQUENCE_DRIVER_SHA256, "Root4 sequence driver pin mismatch")
    _require(sequence.get("source_tree") in (None, root4_ref["source_tree"]), "Root4 sequence source identity mismatch")
    _require(sequence.get("source_commit") in (None, root4_ref["source_commit"]), "Root4 sequence commit identity mismatch")
    rows = sequence.get("records", [])
    _require([row.get("phase") for row in rows] == ROOT4_SEQUENCE_PHASES, "Root4 sequence phase order mismatch")
    _require([row.get("exit_code") for row in rows] == ROOT4_SEQUENCE_EXIT_CODES, "Root4 failed sequence history mismatch")
    python = str(root / "agomtradepro/Scripts/python.exe")
    expected_commands = [
        [python, "-X", "utf8", ".tmp/run_fee_a_bbc7_root4_phase.py", "main"],
        [python, "-X", "utf8", ".tmp/run_fee_a_bbc7_root4_phase.py", "migration"],
        [python, "-X", "utf8", ".tmp/run_fee_a_native_root4.py"],
        [python, "-X", "utf8", ".tmp/run_fee_a_bbc7_root4_phase.py", "browser"],
    ]
    _require([row.get("command") for row in rows] == expected_commands, "Root4 sequence argv mismatch")
    browser_rows = root4_browser_result.get("records", [])
    _require(sha256_path(phase_driver) == ROOT4_PHASE_DRIVER_SHA256, "Root4 phase driver changed")
    _require(root4_browser_result.get("source_tree") == root4_ref["source_tree"], "Root4 browser source tree mismatch")
    _require(root4_browser_result.get("source_commit") == root4_ref["source_commit"], "Root4 browser source commit mismatch")
    _require(root4_browser_result.get("driver_raw_sha256") == ROOT4_PHASE_DRIVER_SHA256, "Root4 browser driver pin mismatch")
    _require(len(browser_rows) == 1 and browser_rows[0].get("label") == "admin", "Root4 browser result shape mismatch")
    browser = browser_rows[0]
    _require(browser.get("exit_code") != 0, "Root4 browser failure was incorrectly changed to green")
    counts = browser.get("counts", {})
    _require(counts.get("total") == 3 and counts.get("failed", 0) + counts.get("errors", 0) == 3,
             "Root4 browser failure history no longer matches the three observed failures")
    browser_log = Path(browser["log"])
    _require(browser_log.is_relative_to(root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-browser-logs"), "Root4 browser log escaped its evidence directory")
    _require(sha256_path(browser_log) == browser.get("log_raw_sha256"), "Root4 browser log pin mismatch")
    _require("SynchronousOnlyOperation" in browser_log.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"),
             "Root4 browser failure signature is missing")

    _require(remaining.get("status") == "stopped_on_failure", "Root4 continuation failure history must be retained")
    _require(sha256_path(remaining_driver) == ROOT4_REMAINING_DRIVER_SHA256, "Root4 continuation driver changed")
    _require(remaining.get("driver_raw_sha256") == ROOT4_REMAINING_DRIVER_SHA256, "Root4 continuation driver pin mismatch")
    remaining_rows = remaining.get("records", [])
    _require(len(remaining_rows) == 1 and remaining_rows[0].get("phase") == "api-edges"
             and remaining_rows[0].get("exit_code") == 1, "Root4 API-edge failure history mismatch")
    _require(remaining_rows[0].get("driver_raw_sha256") == ROOT4_PHASE_DRIVER_SHA256,
             "Root4 API-edge phase driver pin mismatch")
    api_rows = root4_api_edge_result.get("records", [])
    _require(root4_api_edge_result.get("source_tree") == root4_ref["source_tree"], "Root4 API-edge source tree mismatch")
    _require(root4_api_edge_result.get("source_commit") == root4_ref["source_commit"], "Root4 API-edge source commit mismatch")
    _require(root4_api_edge_result.get("driver_raw_sha256") == ROOT4_PHASE_DRIVER_SHA256, "Root4 API-edge driver pin mismatch")
    _require(len(api_rows) == 1 and api_rows[0].get("label") == "transaction" and api_rows[0].get("exit_code") == 1,
             "Root4 API-edge result must remain failed history")
    _require(api_rows[0].get("counts") == ROOT4_API_EDGE_FAILURE_COUNTS and api_rows[0].get("deselected") == 59,
             "Root4 API-edge historical counts changed")
    api_log = Path(api_rows[0]["log"])
    _require(api_log.is_relative_to(root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-api-edges-logs"),
             "Root4 API-edge failure log escaped its evidence directory")
    _require(sha256_path(api_log) == api_rows[0].get("log_raw_sha256"),
             "Root4 API-edge failure log raw pin mismatch")
    artifacts = {
        str(sequence_path.relative_to(root)): sha256_path(sequence_path),
        str(browser_result_path.relative_to(root)): sha256_path(browser_result_path),
        str(api_result_path.relative_to(root)): sha256_path(api_result_path),
        str(remaining_path.relative_to(root)): sha256_path(remaining_path),
        str(sequence_driver.relative_to(root)): ROOT4_SEQUENCE_DRIVER_SHA256,
        str(remaining_driver.relative_to(root)): ROOT4_REMAINING_DRIVER_SHA256,
        str(phase_driver.relative_to(root)): ROOT4_PHASE_DRIVER_SHA256,
        str(browser_log.relative_to(root)): browser["log_raw_sha256"],
        str(api_log.relative_to(root)): api_rows[0]["log_raw_sha256"],
    }
    return {"root4_identity": {"base": root4_ref["base"], "source_commit": root4_ref["source_commit"],
                                "source_tree": root4_ref["source_tree"]},
            "root4_browser_failure": browser, "root4_api_edge_failure": api_rows[0],
            "root4_db_sequence_status": sequence["status"], "root4_remaining_status": remaining["status"],
            "artifacts_raw_sha256": artifacts}


def validate_root4_domain_smoke(
    *, root: Path, root4_ref: dict[str, Any], expected_sequence_sha256: str,
    expected_smoke_report_sha256: str, expected_smoke_retry_path: Path,
    expected_smoke_retry_sha256: str, expected_smoke_retry_driver_path: Path,
    expected_smoke_retry_driver_sha256: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Validate Domain, preserve the failed aggregate smoke, and verify exact retry.

    The Domain driver reported no JUnit field because it searched the wrong
    Windows path. Its log records the actual generated XML path; read and pin
    that XML without modifying either original report. The aggregate smoke's
    one failure remains history; a separate exact-node retry has its own pins.
    """
    prefix = "fee-a-bbc7-root-4"
    sequence_path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-domain-smoke-sequence.json"
    domain_path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-domain-result.json"
    smoke_path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-smoke-result.json"
    smoke_retry_path = expected_smoke_retry_path.resolve()
    _require(sha256_path(sequence_path) == expected_sequence_sha256, "Root4 Domain/smoke sequence raw pin mismatch")
    _require(sha256_path(domain_path) == ROOT4_DOMAIN_REPORT_SHA256, "Root4 Domain report raw pin mismatch")
    _require(sha256_path(smoke_path) == expected_smoke_report_sha256, "Root4 smoke report raw pin mismatch")
    _require(smoke_retry_path.is_relative_to((root / ".tmp").resolve()),
             "Root4 exact smoke retry report escaped ignored evidence")
    _require(sha256_path(smoke_retry_path) == expected_smoke_retry_sha256,
             "Root4 exact smoke retry report raw pin mismatch")
    sequence = load_json(sequence_path)
    domain = load_json(domain_path)
    smoke = load_json(smoke_path)

    sequence_driver = root / ".tmp" / "run_fee_a_root4_domain_smoke.py"
    domain_driver = root / ".tmp" / "run_fee_a_root4_domain_with_junit.py"
    smoke_driver = root / ".tmp" / "run_fee_a_root4_smoke.py"
    _require(sha256_path(sequence_driver) == ROOT4_DOMAIN_SEQUENCE_DRIVER_SHA256,
             "Root4 Domain/smoke sequence driver changed")
    _require(sha256_path(domain_driver) == ROOT4_DOMAIN_DRIVER_SHA256, "Root4 Domain driver changed")
    _require(sha256_path(smoke_driver) == ROOT4_SMOKE_DRIVER_SHA256, "Root4 smoke driver changed")
    _require(sequence.get("status") == "stopped_on_failure",
             "Root4 initial Domain/smoke stop-on-failure history changed")
    _require(sequence.get("driver_raw_sha256") == ROOT4_DOMAIN_SEQUENCE_DRIVER_SHA256,
             "Root4 Domain/smoke sequence driver pin mismatch")
    python = str(root / "agomtradepro/Scripts/python.exe")
    sequence_records = sequence.get("records", [])
    _require([row.get("phase") for row in sequence_records] == ["domain", "smoke"],
             "Root4 Domain/smoke sequence order mismatch")
    _require([row.get("exit_code") for row in sequence_records] == [0, 1],
             "Root4 initial Domain/smoke exit history changed")
    expected_commands = [
        [python, "-X", "utf8", str(domain_driver), "domain"],
        [python, "-X", "utf8", str(smoke_driver), "smoke"],
    ]
    _require([row.get("command") for row in sequence_records] == expected_commands,
             "Root4 Domain/smoke sequence argv mismatch")
    _require([row.get("driver_raw_sha256") for row in sequence_records]
             == [ROOT4_DOMAIN_DRIVER_SHA256, ROOT4_SMOKE_DRIVER_SHA256],
             "Root4 Domain/smoke phase driver pins mismatch")
    artifacts: dict[str, str] = {
        str(sequence_path.relative_to(root)): sha256_path(sequence_path),
        str(domain_path.relative_to(root)): sha256_path(domain_path),
        str(smoke_path.relative_to(root)): sha256_path(smoke_path),
        str(sequence_driver.relative_to(root)): ROOT4_DOMAIN_SEQUENCE_DRIVER_SHA256,
        str(domain_driver.relative_to(root)): ROOT4_DOMAIN_DRIVER_SHA256,
        str(smoke_driver.relative_to(root)): ROOT4_SMOKE_DRIVER_SHA256,
    }

    for phase, data, driver, expected_label in (
        ("domain", domain, domain_driver, "line-gate"),
        ("smoke", smoke, smoke_driver, "minimum-regression"),
    ):
        _require(data.get("phase") == phase and data.get("status") == "commands_finished_review_required",
                 f"Root4 {phase} phase report status mismatch")
        _require(data.get("base") == root4_ref["base"]
                 and data.get("source_tree") == root4_ref["source_tree"]
                 and data.get("source_commit") == root4_ref["source_commit"],
                 f"Root4 {phase} report source identity mismatch")
        _require(data.get("reference_raw_sha256") == sha256_path(root / ".tmp" / "fee-a-bbc7-root-4-reference.json"),
                 f"Root4 {phase} report reference pin mismatch")
        _require(data.get("driver_raw_sha256") == sha256_path(driver), f"Root4 {phase} report driver pin mismatch")
        rows = data.get("records", [])
        _require(len(rows) == 1 and rows[0].get("label") == expected_label and rows[0].get("exit_code") == (0 if phase == "domain" else 1),
                 f"Root4 {phase} phase result shape/status mismatch")
        row = rows[0]
        log = Path(row["log"])
        _require(log.is_relative_to(root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-{phase}-logs"),
                 f"Root4 {phase} log escaped its evidence directory")
        _require(sha256_path(log) == row.get("log_raw_sha256"), f"Root4 {phase} log pin mismatch")
        artifacts[str(log.relative_to(root))] = row["log_raw_sha256"]
        if phase == "domain":
            _require("junit" not in row and "counts" not in row,
                     "Root4 Domain report must retain its original missing-JUnit metadata")
            log_text = log.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
            _require(re.search(r"^collecting \.\.\. collected 4296 items$", log_text, re.MULTILINE) is not None,
                     "Root4 Domain collection count mismatch")
            pass_lines = [line for line in log_text.splitlines() if re.fullmatch(
                r"tests/.+\bPASSED(?:\s+\[[^\]]+\])?(?:Rejected application socket/DNS attempts: 0)?", line)]
            _require(len(pass_lines) == 4296, "Root4 Domain passed-node line count mismatch")
            summary = re.search(r"^=+ 4296 passed in [0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?s(?: \([0-9:]+\))? =+$", log_text, re.MULTILINE)
            _require(summary is not None, "Root4 Domain terminal summary is not 4296 passed")
            coverage = re.search(
                r"^Required test coverage of 90\.0% reached\. Total coverage: ([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%$",
                log_text, re.MULTILINE)
            _require(coverage is not None and float(coverage.group(1)) >= 90.0,
                     "Root4 Domain coverage floor was not reached")
            _require("Rejected application socket/DNS attempts: 0" in log_text,
                     "Root4 Domain local network fence did not report zero attempts")
            xml_match = re.search(r"^- generated xml file: (.+) -$", log_text, re.MULTILINE)
            _require(xml_match is not None, "Root4 Domain log does not disclose generated JUnit path")
            junit = Path(xml_match.group(1).strip())
            export = Path(root4_ref["export"]).resolve()
            _require(junit.resolve().is_relative_to(export), "Root4 Domain JUnit escaped its frozen export")
            _require(junit.is_file(), "Root4 Domain JUnit file is missing")
            cases = list(ET.parse(junit).iter("testcase"))
            counts = {
                "total": len(cases),
                "failed": sum(case.find("failure") is not None for case in cases),
                "errors": sum(case.find("error") is not None for case in cases),
                "skipped": sum(case.find("skipped") is not None for case in cases),
            }
            counts["passed"] = counts["total"] - counts["failed"] - counts["errors"] - counts["skipped"]
            _require(counts == {"total": 4296, "passed": 4296, "failed": 0, "errors": 0, "skipped": 0},
                     "Root4 Domain actual JUnit counts mismatch")
            artifacts[str(junit.relative_to(root))] = sha256_path(junit)
            domain_summary: dict[str, Any] = {
                "total": 4296, "passed": 4296, "failed": 0, "errors": 0, "skipped": 0,
                "coverage_percent": float(coverage.group(1)),
                "junit_raw_sha256": sha256_path(junit),
                "junit_path": str(junit.relative_to(root)),
            }
        else:
            junit_path = Path(row["junit"])
            _require(junit_path.is_relative_to(Path(root4_ref["export"]) / ".tmp"),
                     "Root4 smoke JUnit escaped the export temporary directory")
            _require(sha256_path(junit_path) == row.get("junit_raw_sha256"), "Root4 smoke JUnit pin mismatch")
            cases = list(ET.parse(junit_path).iter("testcase"))
            counts = {"total": len(cases),
                      "failed": sum(case.find("failure") is not None for case in cases),
                      "errors": sum(case.find("error") is not None for case in cases),
                      "skipped": sum(case.find("skipped") is not None for case in cases)}

def validate_projection_whitelist(root: Path, export: Path, review: dict[str, Any], official_outputs: list[str]) -> dict[Path, bytes]:
    """Preflight every projection target before any shared target is written."""
    names = set(review.get("output_lf_sha256", {}))
    _require(names == set(official_outputs) and len(names) == 9, "projection output paths differ from the 9-path whitelist")
    root_resolved = root.resolve()
    writes: dict[Path, bytes] = {}
    targets: list[Path] = []
    for name, pin in review["output_lf_sha256"].items():
        relative = PurePosixPath(name)
        _require(not relative.is_absolute() and ".." not in relative.parts and "\\" not in name
                 and ":" not in name, f"unsafe output path: {name}")
        source = export.joinpath(*relative.parts)
        target = root.joinpath(*relative.parts)
        _require(source.resolve().is_relative_to(export.resolve()), f"export output escapes export: {name}")
        _require(target.resolve().is_relative_to(root_resolved), f"output target escapes repository: {name}")
        targets.append(target)
        raw = source.read_bytes()
        _require(hashlib.sha256(raw.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest() == pin, f"projection LF pin mismatch: {name}")
        _require(target not in writes, f"duplicate output target: {name}")
        writes[target] = raw
    # Check every destination directory in a separate pass before any caller writes.
    for target in targets:
        _require(target.parent.is_dir(), f"missing output parent before writes: {target}")
    return writes


def acceptance_binding(*, acceptance_path: Path, identity: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Create the cross-stage acceptance identity stored by publish/finalize."""
    return {"acceptance_raw_sha256": sha256_path(acceptance_path), "source_identity": identity}


def attach_acceptance_binding(
    *, record: dict[str, Any], acceptance_path: Path, identity: dict[str, Any]
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Attach the same immutable acceptance binding to a downstream record."""
    binding = acceptance_binding(acceptance_path=acceptance_path, identity=identity)
    prior = record.get("acceptance_binding")
    _require(prior in (None, binding), "record already carries a different acceptance binding")
    record["acceptance_binding"] = binding
    return record


def require_acceptance_binding(*, record: dict[str, Any], acceptance_path: Path, identity: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """Reject stale acceptance, root identity, or proof values in later stages."""
    binding = record.get("acceptance_binding", {})
    _require(binding.get("acceptance_raw_sha256") == sha256_path(acceptance_path), "acceptance raw hash changed after publication")
    _require(binding.get("source_identity") == identity, "Root4/Root5 source identity or proof changed after publication")


def require_binding_chain(
    *, records: list[dict[str, Any]], acceptance_path: Path, identity: dict[str, Any]
) -> None:
    """Require every downstream document in publish→postdoc→finalize→commit to match."""
    _require(bool(records), "acceptance binding chain is empty")
    for index, record in enumerate(records):
        try:
            require_acceptance_binding(record=record, acceptance_path=acceptance_path, identity=identity)
        except AssertionError as exc:
            raise AssertionError(f"acceptance binding chain record {index} failed: {exc}") from exc


def root5_commit_scope(*, root5_ref: dict[str, Any], book_paths: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Return the only permitted eventual stage set: 35 Root5 paths + 9 outputs + 4 book paths."""
    owned = list(root5_ref["owned_paths"])
    outputs = list(root5_ref["official_outputs"])
    _require(len(owned) == 35 and len(set(owned)) == 35, "Root5 owned source scope must be exactly 35 unique paths")
    _require(len(outputs) == 9 and len(set(outputs)) == 9, "Root5 official output scope must be exactly 9 unique paths")
    _require(len(book_paths) == 4 and len(set(book_paths)) == 4, "evidence book scope must be exactly 4 unique paths")
    scope = [*owned, *outputs, *book_paths]
    _require(len(scope) == 48 and len(set(scope)) == 48, "Root5 48-path eventual commit scope overlaps or changed")
    return scope

def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def load(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise AssertionError(f"expected JSON object: {path}")
    return value


def git(*args: str, env: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> bytes:
    environment = dict(os.environ, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0")
    if env is not None:
        environment.update(env)
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ["git", *args], cwd=ROOT, env=environment, check=True,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
    )
    return completed.stdout


def build_and_replay_source_patch(final_ref: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Rebuild the exact reviewed source delta and replay it in a disposable index."""
    owned = sorted(final_ref["owned_paths"])
    if len(owned) != 35 or len(set(owned)) != 35:
        raise AssertionError("Root6 owned source path set must contain 35 unique paths")
    source_commit = final_ref["source_commit"]
    source_tree = final_ref["source_tree"]
    if git("rev-parse", f"{source_commit}^{{tree}}").decode("ascii").strip() != source_tree:
        raise AssertionError("Root6 source commit does not resolve to the frozen source tree")
    path_args = ["--", *owned]
    names = git("diff", "--name-only", BASE, source_commit, *path_args).decode("utf-8").splitlines()
    if set(names) != set(owned) or len(names) != len(owned):
        raise AssertionError("canonical source delta paths do not equal the exact 35-path whitelist")
    statuses = git("diff", "--name-status", "--no-renames", BASE, source_commit, *path_args).decode("utf-8").splitlines()
    if {line.split("\t", 1)[1] for line in statuses} != set(owned):
        raise AssertionError("canonical source name-status paths differ from whitelist")
    if any(line.split("\t", 1)[0] not in {"M", "A"} for line in statuses):
        raise AssertionError("canonical source delta has an unexpected status")
    numstat_lines = git("diff", "--numstat", "--no-renames", BASE, source_commit, *path_args).decode("utf-8").splitlines()
    numstat: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {}
    for line in numstat_lines:
        added, deleted, path = line.split("\t", 2)
        if added == "-" or deleted == "-":
            raise AssertionError(f"unexpected binary owned source path: {path}")
        numstat[path] = (int(added), int(deleted))
    if set(numstat) != set(owned) or len(numstat) != len(owned):
        raise AssertionError("canonical source numstat does not cover the exact whitelist")
    patch_bytes = git("diff", "--binary", "--full-index", "--no-ext-diff", "--no-renames",
                      BASE, source_commit, *path_args)
    if not patch_bytes.startswith(b"diff --git "):
        raise AssertionError("canonical source patch is empty or malformed")
    patch_path = TMP / f"{FINAL_PREFIX}-canonical-source.patch"
    if patch_path.exists():
        if patch_path.read_bytes() != patch_bytes:
            raise AssertionError("existing ignored canonical patch differs from frozen source delta")
    else:
        patch_path.write_bytes(patch_bytes)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="fee-a-root6-index-", dir=TMP) as scratch:
        index_path = Path(scratch) / "index"
        env = {"GIT_INDEX_FILE": str(index_path)}
        git("read-tree", BASE, env=env)
        git("apply", "--cached", "--check", str(patch_path), env=env)
        git("apply", "--cached", str(patch_path), env=env)
        replay_tree = git("write-tree", env=env).decode("ascii").strip()
    if replay_tree != source_tree:
        raise AssertionError("canonical source patch replay tree differs from frozen Root6 tree")
    return {
        "path": str(patch_path.relative_to(ROOT)),
        "raw_sha256": sha(patch_path),
        "path_count": len(owned),
        "name_status": statuses,
        "numstat": {path: list(values) for path, values in sorted(numstat.items())},
        "replayed_tree": replay_tree,
    }

+PRICE_QUANTUM = Decimal("0.0001")
+MAX_PRICE = Decimal("9999999999999999.9999")
+MAX_NOTIONAL = Decimal("999999999999999999.99")
+MAX_SHARES = 1_000_000_000_000
+
+
+def _validate_positive_id(value: int, *, field_name: str) -> None:
+    """Require an actual positive integer identifier, excluding booleans."""
+
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value <= 0:
+        raise InvalidInputError("编号必须为正整数", details={"field": field_name})
+
+
+class CreateTransactionUseCase:
+    """Create one transaction after deriving its notional in Application."""
+
+    def __init__(self, repository: TransactionRecordRepositoryProtocol | None = None) -> None:
+        self.repository = repository or get_transaction_record_repository()
+
+    def execute(self, command: CreateTransactionInput) -> TransactionRecord:
+        """Normalize the computed notional and persist through the typed port."""
+        _validate_positive_id(command.actor_user_id, field_name="actor_user_id")
+        _validate_positive_id(command.portfolio_id, field_name="portfolio_id")
+        if command.position_id is not None:
+            _validate_positive_id(command.position_id, field_name="position_id")
+
+        if isinstance(command.shares, bool) or not isinstance(command.shares, (int, float)):
+            raise InvalidInputError("交易数量必须为正有限数", details={"field": "shares"})
+        try:
+            shares = float(command.shares)
+        except (OverflowError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+            raise InvalidInputError("交易数量必须为正有限数", details={"field": "shares"}) from exc
+        if not math.isfinite(shares) or shares <= 0 or shares > MAX_SHARES:
+            raise InvalidInputError(
+                "交易数量必须为允许范围内的正有限数", details={"field": "shares"}
+            )
+
+        if (
+            not isinstance(command.price, Decimal)
+            or not command.price.is_finite()
+            or command.price <= 0
+        ):
+            raise InvalidInputError("成交价格必须为正有限金额", details={"field": "price"})
+        try:
+            price = command.price.quantize(PRICE_QUANTUM, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
+            notional = (Decimal(str(shares)) * price).quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
+        except InvalidOperation as exc:
+            raise InvalidInputError(
+                "成交价格或金额超出允许范围", details={"field": "price"}
+            ) from exc
+        if price <= 0 or price > MAX_PRICE:
+            raise InvalidInputError("成交价格超出允许范围", details={"field": "price"})
+        if notional > MAX_NOTIONAL:
+            raise InvalidInputError("成交金额超出允许范围", details={"field": "shares"})
+        if not isinstance(command.action, str) or command.action not in ("buy", "sell"):
+            raise InvalidInputError("交易方向无效", details={"field": "action"})
+
+        commission = normalize_actual_fee(command.commission, field_name="commission")
+        slippage = normalize_actual_fee(command.slippage, field_name="slippage")
+        stamp_duty = normalize_actual_fee(command.stamp_duty, field_name="stamp_duty")
+        transfer_fee = normalize_actual_fee(command.transfer_fee, field_name="transfer_fee")
+
+        if (
+            not isinstance(command.traded_at, datetime)
+            or command.traded_at.tzinfo is None
+            or command.traded_at.utcoffset() is None
+        ):
+            raise InvalidInputError(
+                "成交时间必须为带时区的 datetime",
+                details={"field": "traded_at"},
+            )
+
+        return self.repository.create_transaction(
+            NewTransactionRecord(
+                actor_user_id=command.actor_user_id,
+                portfolio_id=command.portfolio_id,
+                position_id=command.position_id,
+                action=command.action,
+                asset_code=command.asset_code,
+                shares=shares,
+                price=price,
+                notional=notional,
+                notes=command.notes,
+                traded_at=command.traded_at,
+                commission=commission,
+                slippage=slippage,
+                stamp_duty=stamp_duty,
+                transfer_fee=transfer_fee,
+            )
+        )
+
+
+class ListTransactionPageUseCase:
+    """Read one owner-scoped transaction page."""
+
+    def __init__(self, repository: TransactionRecordRepositoryProtocol | None = None) -> None:
+        self.repository = repository or get_transaction_record_repository()
+
+    def execute(self, *, user_id: int, page_number: int, page_size: int) -> TransactionPage:
+        """Return a typed page using the API's selected pagination values."""
+        _validate_positive_id(user_id, field_name="user_id")
+        _validate_positive_id(page_number, field_name="page")
+        _validate_positive_id(page_size, field_name="page_size")
+        return self.repository.list_user_transactions(
+            user_id,
+            page_number=page_number,
+            page_size=page_size,
+        )
+
+
+class GetTransactionUseCase:
+    """Read a single transaction inside the authenticated user's scope."""
+
+    def __init__(self, repository: TransactionRecordRepositoryProtocol | None = None) -> None:
+        self.repository = repository or get_transaction_record_repository()
+
+    def execute(self, *, user_id: int, transaction_id: int) -> TransactionRecord | None:
+        """Return None for both missing and foreign transaction IDs."""
+        _validate_positive_id(user_id, field_name="user_id")
+        _validate_positive_id(transaction_id, field_name="transaction_id")
+        return self.repository.get_user_transaction(user_id, transaction_id)

+"""Pure variance calculation for the fee-availability candidate."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+from apps.account.domain.transaction_cost_contracts import TransactionCostRecord
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TransactionCostVariance:
+    """Current actual-versus-estimated variance and its optional fraction."""
+
+    cost_variance: Decimal | None
+    cost_variance_pct: float | None
+
+
+def canonical_fee_amount(amount: Decimal | None, known: bool | None) -> Decimal | None:
+    """Expose an amount only when its collection state is explicitly true."""
+    return amount if known is True else None
+
+
+def complete_actual_cost(record: TransactionCostRecord) -> Decimal | None:
+    """Sum actual fees only when every component is explicitly known."""
+    if (
+        record["commission_known"] is not True
+        or record["commission"] is None
+        or record["slippage_known"] is not True
+        or record["slippage"] is None
+        or record["stamp_duty_known"] is not True
+        or record["stamp_duty"] is None
+        or record["transfer_fee_known"] is not True
+        or record["transfer_fee"] is None
+    ):
+        return None
+    return record["commission"] + record["slippage"] + record["stamp_duty"] + record["transfer_fee"]
+
+
+def derive_actual_cost_variance(record: TransactionCostRecord) -> TransactionCostVariance:
+    """Derive variance only from a complete, explicitly known actual-fee set."""
+    actual = complete_actual_cost(record)
+    if actual is None:
+        return TransactionCostVariance(cost_variance=None, cost_variance_pct=None)
+
+    estimate = record["estimated_cost"]
+    if estimate is None:
+        return TransactionCostVariance(cost_variance=None, cost_variance_pct=None)
+
+    variance = actual - estimate
+    variance_pct = float(variance / estimate) if estimate > 0 else None
+    return TransactionCostVariance(cost_variance=variance, cost_variance_pct=variance_pct)

+"""Focused persistence methods for canonical transaction records."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+from django.db import router, transaction
+
+import core.exceptions as core_exceptions
+from apps.account.domain.transaction_record_contracts import (
+    NewTransactionRecord,
+    TransactionPage,
+    TransactionRecord,
+)
+from apps.account.infrastructure.models import PortfolioModel, PositionModel, TransactionModel
+
+
+class TransactionRecordRepositoryMixin:
+    """Create and read typed transaction records through the Account ORM models."""
+
+    def create_transaction(self, record: NewTransactionRecord) -> TransactionRecord:
+        """Create a new account transaction after locked owner rechecks."""
+        using = router.db_for_write(TransactionModel)
+        with transaction.atomic(using=using):
+            try:
+                portfolio = (
+                    PortfolioModel._default_manager.using(using)
+                    .select_for_update(no_key=True)
+                    .get(id=record.portfolio_id)
+                )
+            except PortfolioModel.DoesNotExist as exc:
+                raise core_exceptions.InvalidInputError(
+                    "投资组合不存在",
+                    details={"field": "portfolio"},
+                ) from exc
+            if portfolio.user_id != record.actor_user_id:
+                raise core_exceptions.AuthorizationError("无权为此投资组合创建交易记录")
+
+            position: PositionModel | None = None
+            if record.position_id is not None:
+                position = (
+                    PositionModel._default_manager.using(using)
+                    .select_for_update(no_key=True)
+                    .filter(id=record.position_id, portfolio_id=portfolio.id)
+                    .first()
+                )
+                if position is None:
+                    try:
+                        observed_position = (
+                            PositionModel._default_manager.using(using)
+                            .select_related("portfolio")
+                            .get(id=record.position_id)
+                        )
+                    except PositionModel.DoesNotExist as exc:
+                        raise core_exceptions.InvalidInputError(
+                            "持仓不存在",
+                            details={"field": "position"},
+                        ) from exc
+                    try:
+                        position_owner_id = observed_position.portfolio.user_id
+                    except PortfolioModel.DoesNotExist as exc:
+                        raise core_exceptions.InvalidInputError(
+                            "持仓所属投资组合不存在",
+                            details={"field": "position"},
+                        ) from exc
+                    if position_owner_id != record.actor_user_id:
+                        raise core_exceptions.AuthorizationError("无权为此持仓创建交易记录")
+                    raise core_exceptions.InvalidInputError(
+                        "持仓不属于该投资组合",
+                        details={"field": "position"},
+                    )
+                if position.asset_code != record.asset_code:
+                    raise core_exceptions.InvalidInputError(
+                        "资产代码与关联持仓不一致",
+                        details={"field": "asset_code"},
+                    )
+
+            model = TransactionModel._default_manager.using(using).create(
+                portfolio=portfolio,
+                position=position,
+                action=record.action,
+                asset_code=record.asset_code,
+                shares=record.shares,
+                price=record.price,
+                notional=record.notional,
+                commission=(record.commission if record.commission is not None else Decimal("0")),
+                commission_known=record.commission is not None,
+                slippage=(record.slippage if record.slippage is not None else Decimal("0")),
+                slippage_known=record.slippage is not None,
+                stamp_duty=(record.stamp_duty if record.stamp_duty is not None else Decimal("0")),
+                stamp_duty_known=record.stamp_duty is not None,
+                transfer_fee=(
+                    record.transfer_fee if record.transfer_fee is not None else Decimal("0")
+                ),
+                transfer_fee_known=record.transfer_fee is not None,
+                notes=record.notes,
+                traded_at=record.traded_at,
+            )
+            return self._to_transaction_record(model)
+
+    def list_user_transactions(
+        self,
+        user_id: int,
+        *,
+        page_number: int,
+        page_size: int,
+    ) -> TransactionPage:
+        """Return a typed owner-scoped page ordered by traded time."""
+        using = router.db_for_read(TransactionModel)
+        queryset = (
+            TransactionModel._default_manager.using(using)
+            .filter(portfolio__user_id=user_id)
+            .select_related("portfolio")
+        )
+        count = queryset.count()
+        offset = (page_number - 1) * page_size
+        models = queryset.order_by("-traded_at")[offset : offset + page_size]
+        return TransactionPage(
+            count=count,
+            page_number=page_number,
+            page_size=page_size,
+            results=tuple(self._to_transaction_record(model) for model in models),
+        )
+
+    def get_user_transaction(self, user_id: int, transaction_id: int) -> TransactionRecord | None:
+        """Return an owner-scoped record or None for missing/foreign IDs."""
+        using = router.db_for_read(TransactionModel)
+        model = (
+            TransactionModel._default_manager.using(using)
+            .filter(id=transaction_id, portfolio__user_id=user_id)
+            .select_related("portfolio")
+            .first()
+        )
+        return self._to_transaction_record(model) if model is not None else None
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _to_transaction_record(model: TransactionModel) -> TransactionRecord:
+        """Project one ORM row into the canonical transaction DTO."""
+        return TransactionRecord(
+            id=model.id,
+            portfolio_id=model.portfolio_id,
+            portfolio_name=model.portfolio.name,
+            position_id=model.position_id,
+            asset_code=model.asset_code,
+            action=model.action,
+            shares=model.shares,
+            price=model.price,
+            notional=model.notional,
+            commission=model.commission if model.commission_known is True else None,
+            commission_known=model.commission_known,
+            slippage=model.slippage if model.slippage_known is True else None,
+            slippage_known=model.slippage_known,
+            stamp_duty=model.stamp_duty if model.stamp_duty_known is True else None,
+            stamp_duty_known=model.stamp_duty_known,
+            transfer_fee=model.transfer_fee if model.transfer_fee_known is True else None,
+            transfer_fee_known=model.transfer_fee_known,
+            broker_name=model.broker_name,
+            external_trade_id=model.external_trade_id,
+            broker_trade_key=model.broker_trade_key,
+            import_batch_id=model.import_batch_id,
+            notes=model.notes,
+            traded_at=model.traded_at,
+            created_at=model.created_at,
+        )

 - `/api/account/portfolios/*` 保留为旧账本兼容入口。
 
+### 9.2 交易费用可用性与响应契约
+
+`/api/account/transactions/` 是现有交易记录入口：GET 返回当前用户范围内的分页列表，POST 创建交易；`/api/account/transactions/{id}/` 的 GET 返回当前用户范围内的单笔记录。创建请求中的 `portfolio` 是旧 Account `PortfolioModel` 主键，`position` 是旧 Account `PositionModel` 主键；这两个字段不接受 canonical `SimulatedAccount` / `account_id`。创建请求先验证组合归属，再检查可选持仓；当组合和持仓均不属于当前用户时，优先返回组合归属拒绝。费用字段随交易记录读写，不新增费用汇总 API。
+
+创建请求中的 `commission`、`slippage`、`stamp_duty`、`transfer_fee` 均为可选非负金额。省略、`null` 或空字符串表示未知；显式 `0` 表示已知的零金额。客户端提交的 `*_known` 字段由服务端控制，会被忽略，不能用来声明费用已采集。
+
+HTTP 创建和后台修正表单的费用最多接受两位小数，单项上限为 `99999999.99`。手工成交导入对已提供的费用按分使用 `ROUND_HALF_UP` 归一化，并在舍入后检查同一上限；例如 `0.005` 为 `0.01`，`0.004` 为已采集的 `0.00`。缺失或空白不参与舍入，原始导入文本保留在审计字段中。
+
+响应中的金额和可用性标记按以下语义配对：
+
+| `*_known` | 费用金额 | 含义 |
+|---|---|---|
+| `true` | JSON decimal 字符串（例如 "0.00"，包括零） | 已采集的实际费用 |
+| `false` | `null` | 明确未采集；底层占位值不作为实际金额返回 |
+| `null` | `null` | 可用状态未声明/未知（包括历史记录或未显式设置状态的记录） |
+
+创建成功仍返回 HTTP `201`，保留现有响应字段并返回四项费用及只读 `*_known` 标记；响应不增加 `id`。`GET` 列表和详情返回相同的费用/标记语义。
+
+| 状态码 | 边界 |
+|---|---|
+| `400` | 请求字段不合法，例如费用为负数，或组合/持仓引用无效。 |
+| `403` | 已认证用户没有相应交易权限，或不能在目标组合/持仓下创建交易。 |
+| `404` | 交易详情不存在或不属于当前用户；无效详情 ID 也按未找到处理。 |
+| `405` | 该交易 API 不支持的 HTTP 方法；交易记录保持追加式，详情不支持 PATCH/DELETE。 |
+
+后台“修正交易费用”入口允许逐项修正：留空表示保留该项原值和状态，输入 `0` 表示已知的零金额；至少提交一项费用。历史字段迁移只添加可空状态，不从旧占位值或估算值推断实际费用。迁移到账本时，已存在映射的交易按幂等规则跳过；对尚未映射的交易，只有四项 `*_known` 全部为 `true` 才迁移，否则跳过并计入未知费用跳过数。
+
+这些费用值保留记录中的原始金额口径；当前接口不做币种换算或人民币归一。当前公开 Account 交易接口提供记录创建、列表和详情，不提供费用聚合端点。
+

+def test_postgres_owner_change_while_waiting_is_rechecked_under_lock() -> None:
+    if connection.vendor != "postgresql":
+        pytest.skip("requires PostgreSQL row locks and pg_blocking_pids")
+
+    owner = _new_user("pg-owner-race")
+    replacement_owner = _new_user("pg-new-owner-race")
+    portfolio = _new_portfolio(owner, "pg-owner-race")
+    row = _new_transaction(portfolio)
+    before = _cost_state(row)
+    worker_pid_queue: Queue[int] = Queue()
+
+    def attempt_update() -> TransactionCostRecord | None:
+        """Run the real repository call with bounded lock and statement waits."""
+
+        close_old_connections()
+        worker_connection = connections["default"]
+        try:
+            with worker_connection.cursor() as cursor:
+                cursor.execute("SET lock_timeout = '6000ms'")
+                cursor.execute("SET statement_timeout = '9000ms'")
+                cursor.execute("SELECT pg_backend_pid()")
+                pid_row = cursor.fetchone()
+            assert pid_row is not None
+            worker_pid_queue.put(int(pid_row[0]))
+            return TransactionRepository().update_transaction_costs(
+                row.pk,
+                actor_user_id=owner.pk,
+                commission=Decimal("99"),
+            )
+        finally:
+            worker_connection.close()
+
+    with ThreadPoolExecutor(
+        max_workers=1,
+        thread_name_prefix="ash-fee-owner-race-repository-update",
+    ) as executor:
+        with transaction.atomic():
+            with connections["default"].cursor() as cursor:
+                cursor.execute("SELECT pg_backend_pid()")
+                main_pid_row = cursor.fetchone()
+            assert main_pid_row is not None
+            main_pid = int(main_pid_row[0])
+            locked_portfolio = PortfolioModel._default_manager.select_for_update().get(
+                pk=portfolio.pk
+            )
+            locked_portfolio.user_id = replacement_owner.pk
+            locked_portfolio.save(update_fields=["user"])
+
+            future = executor.submit(attempt_update)
+            worker_pid = worker_pid_queue.get(timeout=5)
+            assert worker_pid != main_pid
+            deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
+            blocker_pids: tuple[int, ...] = ()
+            while time.monotonic() < deadline and not future.done():
+                blocker_pids = _pg_blocking_pids(worker_pid)
+                if main_pid in blocker_pids:
+                    break
+                time.sleep(0.02)
+
+            assert main_pid in blocker_pids, (
+                "repository contender never appeared in pg_blocking_pids; "
+                f"last blockers were {blocker_pids}"
+            )
+
+        result = future.result(timeout=10)
+    assert result is None
+    assert PortfolioModel._default_manager.get(pk=portfolio.pk).user_id == replacement_owner.pk
+    assert _cost_state(TransactionModel._default_manager.get(pk=row.pk)) == before

+def _run_pg_repository_operation(
+    operation: Callable[[], object],
+    worker_pid_queue: Queue[int],
+) -> object:
+    """Run a real repository call on its own bounded PostgreSQL connection."""
+
+    close_old_connections()
+    worker_connection = connections["default"]
+    try:
+        with worker_connection.cursor() as cursor:
+            cursor.execute("SET lock_timeout = '6000ms'")
+            cursor.execute("SET statement_timeout = '9000ms'")
+            cursor.execute("SELECT pg_backend_pid()")
+            pid_row = cursor.fetchone()
+        assert pid_row is not None
+        worker_pid_queue.put(int(pid_row[0]))
+        return operation()
+    finally:
+        worker_connection.close()
+
+
+def _pg_main_backend_pid() -> int:
+    """Return the calling connection's real PostgreSQL backend PID."""
+
+    with connections["default"].cursor() as cursor:
+        cursor.execute("SELECT pg_backend_pid()")
+        pid_row = cursor.fetchone()
+    assert pid_row is not None
+    return int(pid_row[0])
+
+
+def _wait_for_pg_block_or_completion(
+    worker_pid: int,
+    main_pid: int,
+    future: Future[object],
+) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    """Wait for an observed blocker or completed repository call, with a bound."""
+
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
+    blocker_pids: tuple[int, ...] = ()
+    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+        blocker_pids = _pg_blocking_pids(worker_pid)
+        if main_pid in blocker_pids or future.done():
+            return blocker_pids
+        time.sleep(0.02)
+    return blocker_pids
+
+
+def _finish_pg_worker(
+    executor: ThreadPoolExecutor,
+    future: Future[object] | None,
+) -> None:
+    """Join the worker only after the surrounding main transaction has released locks."""
+
+    if future is not None:
+        try:
+            future.result(timeout=10)
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+    executor.shutdown(wait=True, cancel_futures=True)
+

+def _run_database_call(
+    function: Callable[_P, _R],
+    *args: _P.args,
+    **kwargs: _P.kwargs,
+) -> _R:
+    """Run one synchronous ORM helper on a dedicated worker thread."""
+
+    def invoke() -> _R:
+        try:
+            return function(*args, **kwargs)
+        finally:
+            connections.close_all()
+
+    with ThreadPoolExecutor(
+        max_workers=1,
+        thread_name_prefix="fee-admin-browser-db",
+    ) as executor:
+        return executor.submit(invoke).result()
+
+
+def _database_thread(function: Callable[_P, _R]) -> Callable[_P, _R]:
+    """Keep synchronous Django ORM helpers off Playwright's event-loop thread."""
+
+    @wraps(function)
+    def wrapped(*args: _P.args, **kwargs: _P.kwargs) -> _R:
+        return _run_database_call(function, *args, **kwargs)
+
+    return wrapped

+def _assert_local_requests(request_urls: list[str], base_url: str) -> None:
+    """Verify observed requests use only the exact isolated live-server origin."""
+
+    expected_origin = _network_origin(base_url)
+    assert expected_origin is not None
+    assert request_urls
+    assert all(_network_origin(url) == expected_origin for url in request_urls)

+def _network_origin(url: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
+    """Normalize network origins while preserving exact host and port."""
+
+    parsed = urlsplit(url)
+    scheme = parsed.scheme.lower()
+    if scheme == "ws":
+        scheme = "http"
+    elif scheme == "wss":
+        scheme = "https"
+    if not scheme or not parsed.netloc:
+        return None
+    return scheme, parsed.netloc.lower()
+

+def _guarded_context(
+    browser: Browser,
+    base_url: str,
+) -> tuple[BrowserContext, list[str]]:
+    """Create a context that routes only to the exact live-server origin."""
+
+    expected_origin = _network_origin(base_url)
+    assert expected_origin is not None
+    blocked_urls: list[str] = []
+    context = browser.new_context(
+        viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 900},
+        service_workers="block",
+    )
+
+    def route_http_request(route: Route) -> None:
+        """Continue real local requests and abort every other network request."""
+
+        request_url = route.request.url
+        if _network_origin(request_url) == expected_origin:
+            route.continue_()
+            return
+        blocked_urls.append(request_url)
+        route.abort("blockedbyclient")
+
+    def route_websocket(websocket: WebSocketRoute) -> None:
+        """Connect only same-origin WebSockets and close external attempts."""
+
+        if _network_origin(websocket.url) == expected_origin:
+            websocket.connect_to_server()
+            return
+        blocked_urls.append(websocket.url)
+        websocket.close(code=1008, reason="external network is disabled in this test")
+
+    context.route("**/*", route_http_request)
+    context.route_web_socket("**/*", route_websocket)
+    return context, blocked_urls
+

+    """Fail with the attempted URLs after the browser has blocked them."""

+"""Real Admin workflow checks for transaction fee availability and correction."""
+
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+from django.contrib.admin.models import ADDITION, CHANGE, LogEntry
+from django.contrib.auth.models import User

+from django.urls import reverse
+from django.utils import timezone
+
+from apps.account.infrastructure.models import PortfolioModel, TransactionModel
+
+
+class TransactionFeeAdminWorkflowTests(TestCase):
+    """Exercise the registered Admin through authenticated HTTP requests."""
+
+    def setUp(self) -> None:
+        self.owner = User.objects.create_superuser(
+            username="fee_admin_owner",
+            email="fee-admin-owner@example.com",
+            password="Pass123!@#",
+        )
+        self.portfolio = PortfolioModel.objects.create(
+            user=self.owner,
+            name="Owned fee-test portfolio",
+        )
+        self.client = Client(enforce_csrf_checks=True)
+        self.client.force_login(self.owner)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _csrf_token(client: Client) -> str:
+        """Return the token cookie created by a real Admin GET request."""
+        cookie = client.cookies.get("csrftoken")
+        if cookie is None:
+            raise AssertionError("Admin GET did not establish a CSRF cookie")
+        return str(cookie.value)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _add_payload(portfolio_id: int) -> dict[str, str]:
+        """Build only the eight fields exposed by the transaction add form."""
+        return {
+            "portfolio": str(portfolio_id),
+            "position": "",
+            "action": "buy",
+            "asset_code": "600000.SH",
+            "shares": "5",
+            "price": "10.25",
+            "traded_at_0": "2026-10-17",
+            "traded_at_1": "09:30:00",
+            "notes": "Admin fee availability workflow",
+        }
+
+    def _create_transaction(
+        self,
+        *,
+        portfolio: PortfolioModel,
+        commission: Decimal = Decimal("0.00"),
+        commission_known: bool | None = False,
+        slippage: Decimal = Decimal("0.00"),
+        slippage_known: bool | None = False,
+        stamp_duty: Decimal = Decimal("0.00"),
+        stamp_duty_known: bool | None = False,
+        transfer_fee: Decimal = Decimal("0.00"),
+        transfer_fee_known: bool | None = False,
+        estimated_cost: Decimal | None = None,
+        cost_variance: Decimal | None = None,
+        cost_variance_pct: float | None = None,
+    ) -> TransactionModel:
+        """Seed a persisted transaction for display and correction requests."""
+        return TransactionModel.objects.create(
+            portfolio=portfolio,
+            action="buy",
+            asset_code="600000.SH",
+            shares=5.0,
+            price=Decimal("10.2500"),
+            notional=Decimal("51.25"),
+            commission=commission,
+            commission_known=commission_known,
+            slippage=slippage,
+            slippage_known=slippage_known,
+            stamp_duty=stamp_duty,
+            stamp_duty_known=stamp_duty_known,
+            transfer_fee=transfer_fee,
+            transfer_fee_known=transfer_fee_known,
+            estimated_cost=estimated_cost,
+            cost_variance=cost_variance,
+            cost_variance_pct=cost_variance_pct,
+            traded_at=timezone.now(),
+            notes="Admin fee workflow seed",

+
+    def test_add_uses_eight_field_form_application_and_one_admin_log(self) -> None:
+        """A real CSRF-checked add creates one unknown-cost ledger row."""
+        add_url = reverse("admin:account_transactionmodel_add")
+        page = self.client.get(add_url)
+
+        self.assertEqual(page.status_code, 200)
+        self.assertIsNotNone(page.context)
+        admin_form = page.context["adminform"].form
+        self.assertEqual(
+            tuple(admin_form.fields),
+            (
+                "portfolio",
+                "position",
+                "action",
+                "asset_code",
+                "shares",
+                "price",
+                "traded_at",
+                "notes",
+            ),
+        )
+        for fee_field in (
+            "commission",
+            "slippage",
+            "stamp_duty",
+            "transfer_fee",
+            "commission_known",
+            "slippage_known",
+            "stamp_duty_known",
+            "transfer_fee_known",

+            ).count(),
+            1,
+        )
+
+    def test_admin_add_rejects_a_post_without_csrf_token(self) -> None:
+        """The real Admin middleware rejects a session-authenticated forged POST."""
+        add_url = reverse("admin:account_transactionmodel_add")
+        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(add_url).status_code, 200)
+
+        response = self.client.post(add_url, self._add_payload(self.portfolio.pk))

+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 403)

+                content_type__app_label="account",
+                content_type__model="transactionmodel",
+                action_flag=ADDITION,

+            0,
+        )
+
+    def test_add_rejects_fee_and_estimate_overpost_with_valid_widget_fields_and_csrf(

+
+        self.assertEqual(page.status_code, 200)
+        csrf_token = self._csrf_token(self.client)

+            with self.subTest(field=forbidden_field):
+                payload = self._add_payload(self.portfolio.pk)

+                    HTTP_X_CSRFTOKEN=csrf_token,

+
+                self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
+                self.assertContains(
+                    response,
+                    "提交包含交易创建表单不接受的字段",
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    TransactionModel.objects.filter(portfolio=self.portfolio).count(),
+                    0,
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    LogEntry.objects.filter(
+                        user=self.owner,
+                        content_type__app_label="account",
+                        content_type__model="transactionmodel",
+                        action_flag=ADDITION,
+                    ).count(),
+                    0,
+                )
+
+    def test_list_and_detail_show_unknown_fees_without_zero_claims(self) -> None:
+        """Legacy NULL availability and zero storage remain visibly unknown."""
+        transaction = self._create_transaction(
+            portfolio=self.portfolio,
+            commission_known=None,
+            slippage_known=None,
+            stamp_duty_known=None,

+
+        list_response = self.client.get(reverse("admin:account_transactionmodel_changelist"))

+            self.assertContains(response, "印花税 未知/未采集")
+            self.assertContains(response, "过户费 未知/未采集")
+            self.assertNotContains(response, "手续费 0.00")
+
+    def test_partial_correction_preserves_blanks_and_recomputes_full_variance(self) -> None:
+        """Blank components persist, explicit zero is known, and all fees are summed."""
+        transaction = self._create_transaction(
+            portfolio=self.portfolio,
+            commission=Decimal("1.00"),
+            commission_known=True,
+            slippage=Decimal("0.00"),
+            slippage_known=False,
+            stamp_duty=Decimal("3.00"),
+            stamp_duty_known=True,
+            transfer_fee=Decimal("4.00"),
+            transfer_fee_known=True,

+            "admin:account_transactionmodel_correct_costs",
+            args=[transaction.pk],
+        )
+        page = self.client.get(correction_url)
+
+        self.assertEqual(page.status_code, 200)
+        self.assertContains(page, "留空表示保留当前值")
+        response = self.client.post(
+            correction_url,
+            {
+                "commission": "",
+                "slippage": "0",
+                "stamp_duty": "",
+                "transfer_fee": "",
+            },
+            HTTP_X_CSRFTOKEN=self._csrf_token(self.client),
+        )
+
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 302)
+        transaction.refresh_from_db()
+        self.assertEqual(transaction.commission, Decimal("1.00"))
+        self.assertEqual(transaction.slippage, Decimal("0.00"))
+        self.assertEqual(transaction.stamp_duty, Decimal("3.00"))
+        self.assertEqual(transaction.transfer_fee, Decimal("4.00"))
+        self.assertTrue(transaction.commission_known)

+        self.assertTrue(transaction.stamp_duty_known)
+        self.assertTrue(transaction.transfer_fee_known)
+        self.assertEqual(transaction.cost_variance, Decimal("-2.00"))
+        self.assertIsNotNone(transaction.cost_variance_pct)

+        self.assertEqual(
+            LogEntry.objects.filter(
+                user=self.owner,
+                content_type__app_label="account",
+                content_type__model="transactionmodel",
+                object_id=str(transaction.pk),
+                action_flag=CHANGE,
+            ).count(),
+            1,
+        )
+
+    def test_foreign_owner_add_and_correction_are_denied_and_change_permission_is_required(
+        self,
+    ) -> None:

+        self.assertEqual(correction_response.status_code, 403)

+"""Private historical-row fidelity test for Account migration 0067."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Iterator
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+import pytest
+from django.apps import apps as django_apps
+from django.conf import settings
+from django.db import connection
+from django.db.migrations.executor import MigrationExecutor
+
+_PARTIAL_APP_NAMES = ("django.contrib.auth", "django.contrib.contenttypes")
+_BEFORE = ("account", "0066_account_authority_generation_lock")
+_AFTER = ("account", "0067_transaction_fee_availability_flags")
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.django_db(
+    transaction=True,
+    available_apps=list(_PARTIAL_APP_NAMES),
+)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def _migration_executor_uses_full_app_registry(transactional_db: None) -> Iterator[None]:
+    """Temporarily expand pytest's partial flush registry for migration loading."""
+
+    del transactional_db
+    expected_partial_names = tuple(sorted(_PARTIAL_APP_NAMES))
+    popped_layers: list[tuple[str, ...]] = []
+    try:
+        for _ in range(4):
+            current_names = tuple(sorted(config.name for config in django_apps.get_app_configs()))
+            if django_apps.is_installed("apps.account"):
+                break
+            assert current_names == expected_partial_names
+            django_apps.unset_available_apps()
+            popped_layers.append(current_names)
+        assert django_apps.is_installed("apps.account")
+        yield
+    finally:
+        for layer_names in reversed(popped_layers):
+            django_apps.set_available_apps(layer_names)
+
+
+def test_0067_preserves_legacy_fees_and_leaves_all_availability_unknown(
+    django_db_use_migrations: bool,
+) -> None:
+    """Real historical rows keep money and execution time without inferred flags."""
+
+    if not django_db_use_migrations:
+        pytest.skip("Account fee migration proof requires a migrations-enabled test database")
+    assert settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL == "auth.User"
+
+    executor = MigrationExecutor(connection)
+    leaf_nodes = executor.loader.graph.leaf_nodes()
+    assert _AFTER in executor.loader.graph.nodes
+
+    username = f"fee-schema-{uuid4().hex}"
+    portfolio_name = f"fee-schema-{uuid4().hex}"
+    before_apps = None
+    transaction_ids: list[int] = []
+
+    try:
+        executor.migrate([_BEFORE])
+        executor = MigrationExecutor(connection)
+        before_apps = executor.loader.project_state([_BEFORE]).apps
+        User = before_apps.get_model("auth", "User")
+        Portfolio = before_apps.get_model("account", "PortfolioModel")
+        Transaction = before_apps.get_model("account", "TransactionModel")
+
+        User._default_manager.bulk_create(
+            [
+                User(
+                    username=username,
+                    password="!",
+                    email="",
+                    first_name="",
+                    last_name="",
+                    is_staff=False,
+                    is_active=True,
+                    is_superuser=False,
+                    date_joined=datetime(2026, 10, 17, 0, 0, tzinfo=UTC),
+                )
+            ]
+        )
+        user = User._default_manager.get(username=username)
+        portfolio = Portfolio._default_manager.create(
+            user_id=user.pk,
+            name=portfolio_name,
+        )
+
+        expected_rows: dict[
+            int,
+            tuple[tuple[Decimal, Decimal, Decimal, Decimal], datetime],
+        ] = {}
+        examples = (
+            (
+                (Decimal("0.00"), Decimal("0.00"), Decimal("0.00"), Decimal("0.00")),
+                datetime(2024, 3, 4, 1, 2, tzinfo=UTC),
+                Decimal("0.01"),
+                {"fees": {"commission": "0.00", "slippage": "0.00"}},
+            ),
+            (
+                (Decimal("1.25"), Decimal("0.50"), Decimal("0.30"), Decimal("0.05")),
+                datetime(2025, 7, 8, 9, 10, tzinfo=UTC),
+                Decimal("2.10"),
+                {
+                    "fees": {
+                        "commission": "1.25",
+                        "slippage": "0.50",
+                        "stamp_duty": "0.30",
+                        "transfer_fee": "0.05",
+                    }
+                },
+            ),
+        )
+        for index, (fees, traded_at, estimate, raw_payload) in enumerate(examples):
+            record = Transaction._default_manager.create(
+                portfolio_id=portfolio.pk,
+                action="buy",
+                asset_code=f"MIGRATION-{index}",
+                shares=10.0,
+                price=Decimal("12.3400"),
+                notional=Decimal("123.40"),
+                commission=fees[0],
+                slippage=fees[1],
+                stamp_duty=fees[2],
+                transfer_fee=fees[3],

+                raw_payload=raw_payload,
+                traded_at=traded_at,
+                notes="fee availability migration fixture",
+            )
+            transaction_ids.append(record.pk)
+            expected_rows[record.pk] = (fees, traded_at)
+
+        executor = MigrationExecutor(connection)
