"""Freeze only reviewed Fee A sources through a private Git index."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tarfile
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
PREFIX = "fee-a-bbc7-root-4"
BASE = "bbc7d69ff930b6f95a658b7b800837166e263618"
ASSEMBLY = ROOT / ".tmp/ash-fee-atomic-a-assembled-v8-bbc7-20261018"
OUTPUTS = ["docs/plans/web-to-tui-migration-matrix-2026-07-25.csv", "schema.yml",
    "docs/testing/api/openapi.yaml", "docs/testing/api/openapi.json", "governance/module_map.json",
    "governance/data_dictionary.json", "docs/architecture/DATA_DICTIONARY.md",
    "governance/data_center_architecture_inventory.json", "governance/data_center_entrypoints.json"]


def digest(path: Path, lf: bool = False) -> str:
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    return hashlib.sha256(raw.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n") if lf else raw).hexdigest()


def git(*args: str, index: Path | None = None, payload: bytes | None = None) -> bytes:
    env = dict(os.environ, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0")
    if index is not None:
        env["GIT_INDEX_FILE"] = str(index)
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-c", "core.safecrlf=false", *args], cwd=ROOT,
        env=env, input=payload, check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE).stdout


def main() -> None:
    export = ROOT / ".tmp" / f"{PREFIX}-export"
    reference = ROOT / ".tmp" / f"{PREFIX}-reference.json"
    assert not export.exists() and not reference.exists()
    assert git("rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip() == BASE
    assert git("branch", "--show-current").decode().strip() == "dev/next-development"
    assert not git("diff", "--cached", "--name-only")
    index_hash = digest(ROOT / ".git/index")
    prior = json.loads((ROOT / ".tmp/fee-composition-e2ab-root-1-reference.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    for path, expected in prior["protected_raw_sha256"].items():
        assert digest(ROOT / path) == expected
        assert git("status", "--porcelain=v1", "--", path).decode().rstrip("\r\n") == prior["protected_status"][path]
    manifest = json.loads((ASSEMBLY / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert digest(ASSEMBLY / "manifest.json") == "3352444a81ddcdaeddc6cb5e87a1a95afb2dbf21265e7725b038c434deab706f"
    owned = [row["path"] for row in manifest["files"]]
    format_record = ROOT / ".tmp/fee-a-bbc7-root-4-format.json"
    formatted = json.loads(format_record.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    for row in manifest["files"]:
        name = row["path"]
        if name.endswith(".py"):
            assert digest(ROOT / name, True) == formatted["formatted_lf_sha256"][name]
        else:
            assert digest(ROOT / name) == row["raw_sha256"]
    actual = git("status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all").decode().splitlines()
    assert {line[3:] for line in actual} == set(owned) | set(prior["protected_status"])
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="fee-a-index-", dir=ROOT / ".tmp") as directory:
        index = Path(directory) / "index"
        git("read-tree", BASE, index=index)
        git("add", "--", *owned, index=index)
        tree = git("write-tree", index=index).decode().strip()
        commit = git("commit-tree", tree, "-p", BASE, payload=f"Freeze {PREFIX} sources\n".encode()).decode().strip()
    assert set(git("diff", "--name-only", BASE, commit).decode().splitlines()) == set(owned)
    archive = ROOT / ".tmp" / f"{PREFIX}-source.tar"
    assert not archive.exists()
    git("archive", "--format=tar", f"--output={archive}", commit)
    export.mkdir()
    with tarfile.open(archive) as stream:
        stream.extractall(export, filter="data")
    (export / ".tmp").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    baseline = json.loads((ROOT / ".tmp/fee-a-bbc7-root-red-1-reference.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    for name, pin in baseline["settings_lf_sha256"].items():
        source = Path(baseline["export"]) / name
        assert digest(source, True) == pin
        shutil.copy2(source, export / name)
    protected_copy = baseline["protected_copy"]
    name = protected_copy["path"]
    assert digest(ROOT / name) == protected_copy["raw_sha256"]
    shutil.copy2(ROOT / name, export / name)
    tracked = git("ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", commit).decode().splitlines()
    record = {"status": "frozen_sources_generators_and_qa_not_run", "base": BASE,
        "source_tree": tree, "source_commit": commit, "export": str(export), "owned_paths": owned,
        "production": [n for n in owned if n.endswith(".py") and not n.startswith("tests/")],
        "changed_tests": [n for n in owned if n.startswith("tests/")], "official_outputs": OUTPUTS,
        "source_lf_sha256": {n: digest(export / n, True) for n in owned},
        "all_python_lf_sha256": {n: digest(export / n, True) for n in tracked if n.endswith(".py")},
        "runtime_lf_sha256": {n: digest(export / n, True) for n in tracked
            if n.startswith(("config/", "governance/")) and n not in OUTPUTS},
        "output_base_lf_sha256": {n: digest(export / n, True) for n in OUTPUTS},

# Fee A static review of Root3 frozen source

- Scope: static source review only; no Django import, pytest, database access, generator, or shared-file write was performed.
- Snapshot: `.tmp/fee-a-bbc7-root-3-reference.json`, base `bbc7d69ff930b6f95a658b7b800837166e263618`, source tree `481f860e1a7538ae077c33a1fa2833136c9fee38`, export `.tmp/fee-a-bbc7-root-3-export`.
- The reference LF hashes match the inspected export for the reviewed files (`repositories.py` `4fdeebca…`, `transaction_cost_use_cases.py` `549b924d…`, `admin.py` `bfff3d87…`, migration command `9a6eade2…`, calculation helper `126cbba8…`, template `3593128d…`).

## Static findings

1. **Unknown and zero are separated at the account ledger boundary.** `TransactionModel` has four nullable `*_known` flags defaulting to `None` (`apps/account/infrastructure/portfolio_models.py:234-270`); migration `0067` only adds those nullable fields with `default=None`, with no backfill (`apps/account/migrations/0067_transaction_fee_availability_flags.py`). `canonical_fee_amount` returns the stored amount only for `known is True`; `complete_actual_cost` requires every flag to be exactly true and every amount present (`apps/account/domain/transaction_cost_calculations.py:19-43`). Thus known `Decimal('0')` is a real zero sample, while a legacy raw zero or nonzero under `False`/`None` stays unavailable.

2. **New writes preserve that distinction.** `TransactionRecordRepository.create_transaction` stores a zero placeholder only when an optional amount is absent and sets its `*_known` state from amount presence (`apps/account/infrastructure/repositories.py:135-155`). The manual-import repository does the same for its three imported fee columns and explicitly stores slippage zero with `slippage_known=False`, since the import contract does not supply slippage (`repositories.py:464-508`). These placeholders are not exposed by canonical record projections (`repositories.py:193-221, 358-380`).

3. **Analysis and variance handling are consistent.** `TransactionCostAnalysisUseCase` derives samples via `complete_actual_cost`, keeps actual and estimate-paired cohorts separate, returns `None` for empty metrics, excludes zero estimates from percentage/accuracy denominators, and counts positive-notional ratios only (`transaction_cost_use_cases.py:271-413`). `derive_actual_cost_variance` clears both derived values for incomplete fees or missing estimate and returns an absolute variance with null percentage when estimate is zero (`transaction_cost_calculations.py:40-48`). The repository tests include a partial correction yielding `18 - 10 = 8`, stale-derived clearing, a zero-estimate case, individual fee upper bounds, and variance overflow rejection with the complete old row preserved (`tests/component/account/test_transaction_cost_availability_repository.py:261-353, 839-899`).

4. **Owner checks are refreshed under the writer transaction.** `RecordTransactionCostUseCase` validates actor/record IDs, rejects an all-`None` patch, normalizes nonnegative finite Decimal inputs, and maps repository `None` to a non-enumerating `AuthorizationError` (`transaction_cost_use_cases.py:34-47, 215-262`). `TransactionRepository.update_transaction_costs` routes to the write DB, starts `atomic`, reads the portfolio ID, locks the portfolio, checks `user_id`, then locks/reloads the transaction constrained to that portfolio before applying the patch; it recomputes from the fresh row, validates the Decimal field before `save`, and saves inside the same transaction (`repositories.py:268-335`). The PG test holds and changes the owner row while the repository contender is blocked, then asserts the old owner gets `None` and the ledger state is unchanged (`tests/component/account/test_transaction_cost_availability_repository.py:505-572`).

5. **Admin form semantics are sound statically.** The list/detail display canonical fees and says “未知/未采集” for unavailable amounts (`apps/account/interface/admin.py:274-289`). The custom correction route is wrapped in `admin_site.admin_view`; it checks model change permission and delegates the patch with the authenticated actor ID (`admin.py:365-432`). The form has four optional, nonnegative `DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2)` controls; blank cleans to `None`, explicit zero remains a Decimal zero, and all-blank submissions are rejected (`admin.py:544-572`). The template includes `{% csrf_token %}` and renders `form.as_p` (`core/templates/admin/account/transaction/correct_costs.html`). Invalid per-field amounts fail form validation; aggregate variance overflow becomes a form error before a successful redirect. The browser/workflow tests cover known zero vs unknown display, blank-preserve, explicit-zero correction, negative/out-of-range/aggregate overflow non-writes, missing-CSRF denial, foreign-owner POST denial, model permission denial, and one successful Admin log entry (`tests/component/account/test_transaction_fee_admin_browser_journey.py:247-534`; `test_transaction_fee_admin_workflow.py:232-346`). The Admin log is recorded after the Application call commits; these sources do not claim the data update and `LogEntry` share one transaction.

6. **Unmapped migration behavior is guarded.** The new `_migrate_transactions` checks an existing transaction map first, then requires all four states to be exactly `True`, then validates positive finite quantity, Decimal fees, and target field bounds; it uses BUY `amount + fees` vs SELL `fees`, writes the source `traded_at` into `execution_time` within the trade/map atomic block (`apps/simulated_trading/management/commands/migrate_account_ledger.py:342-462`). The real-ORM migration component tests cover each individual unknown flag (`False` and `None`) in dry-run/apply with no trade/map, known BUY/SELL totals, existing-map idempotence, source execution time, quantity bounds, and exact Decimal values (`tests/component/simulated_trading/test_migrate_account_ledger_fee_availability.py:86-276, 294-389`).

## Residual: old mapped transactions cannot be repaired by this batch

The current map-first guard is at `migrate_account_ledger.py:350-352`, before the new four-flag gate at `:354-365`. The frozen base command at `bbc7…` also used map-first (`git show bbc7…:apps/simulated_trading/management/commands/migrate_account_ledger.py:343-349`) and then copied `commission`, forced `slippage=0`, and set `total_cost=commission` (`:363-390`) without any availability flags. The target `SimulatedTradeModel` has fee amount fields but no `commission_known`, `slippage_known`, `stamp_duty_known`, or `transfer_fee_known` fields (`apps/simulated_trading/infrastructure/simulated_account_trade_models.py:217-226`).

Therefore Fee A's new unknown gate protects **previously unmapped** source transactions. If an older run already created a transaction migration map, rerunning this command skips the row before inspecting its new source availability flags; the target trade retains its old fee values and cannot encode whether zero meant known zero or a placeholder. Whether production contains such rows was not inspected. The migration and existing-map idempotence should remain unchanged in this batch; do not claim that it repairs the historical target ledger.

A separate, explicitly approved reconciliation slice would need to:

- establish the exact candidate population from `LedgerMigrationMapModel` rows for `source_app=account`, `source_table=transaction`, and `target_table=simulated_trade`; require exactly one source/map/target, verify source portfolio map and target account owner/portfolio identity, and report missing/duplicate/foreign/mismatched links without writing;
- keep unknown/false/null source fees unknown; never infer collection from raw zero/nonzero amounts, `raw_payload`, old target values, or estimates. Only update fee amounts when all four source flags are explicitly true and all four values are present, finite, nonnegative, and within target limits;
- decide how the target ledger represents availability before writing: the current SimulatedTrade schema cannot represent unknown-vs-zero for non-null commission/slippage. Either preserve these historical targets untouched and document the limitation, or separately authorize a versioned target availability schema/projection. Do not silently coerce unknown values to zero or `True`;
- for eligible rows, verify a complete source-to-target relationship and expected identity fields, compute BUY/SELL totals from exact Decimal values, preserve source execution time only under a documented provenance rule, and validate every target Decimal bound before changes;
- use a dry-run inventory, bounded ownership/row locks with fresh source/map/target rechecks, per-row atomic updates, stable audit output, failure rollback tests, repeated-run idempotence, and explicit before/after counts. Unknown and ineligible rows must be proved unchanged.

No reconciliation code or test was written here; this is an open data-history question for Root's plan.

Reviewed the apply preflight, focused runner, and formatted Root5 browser test as read-only inputs. Only one-off Python -S standard-library reads, hashes, and XML parsing were used; no project script, QA, database, browser, or shared-file write was performed.

Raw SHA-256 pins:

- `.tmp/apply_fee_a_root5_reviewed.py`: `77b72a7e7568ed8b01a2dee98560d407872624626d5f52ad2babc26cb0cd658a` (updated to require the stopped smoke sequence and retry evidence)
- `.tmp/run_fee_a_root5_focused.py`: `eaa6ecbe766c7331f717b822b1686cc15c94f271d3669686b5ab22fb32f2031b`
- `.tmp/fee-a-bbc7-root-5-export/tests/component/account/test_transaction_fee_admin_browser_journey.py`: `e177d54eb91610c87f8c5372b565f1b53976611b13e8a3cdb23cc4ffd039a71e` (LF SHA-256: `6d771c374a057d3ea1cb0a30a05c320673170adbc490381b22e210f3900ccc35`)

The apply script checks the Root4 frozen state, HEAD/branch, protected-file and index pins, the exact three-path Root5 delta, the candidate source hashes, and unchanged production inputs before copying the reviewed files. It saves private preimages and writes only the browser test, API edge test, and API reference document. The later source/index assertions repeat already-pinned state checks; the Root4 verifier and Root5 preparation carry matching protected-file and index hashes before mutation.

The revised preflight now requires the original sequence to be `stopped_on_failure` with ordered `domain=0, smoke=1`, and a same-source-tree/commit single-test retry result with one pass and no failures/errors/skips. The retry artifact's driver, log, JUnit, and plugin digests match their files. The retained original smoke result is 404 total: 403 passed, 1 failed, 0 errors, 0 skipped. The failing test is `test_retried_business_503_preserves_final_response`; the log shows the broad local-network fence blocked `socket.gethostbyaddr` while `ThreadingHTTPServer` bound its local test server. The independent retry passed that exact test; its log records 2 registered local HTTP connections, 2 numeric endpoint lookups, 1 numeric server name, and 0 rejected other application socket/DNS attempts. This preserves the original failure and records a narrowly fenced green retry; it does not make the 404-test smoke phase green.

One remaining preflight precision gap: the apply script checks retry aggregate counts and artifact digests, but does not assert `retry["actual_nodes"]` or the command's selected node equals the named SDK retry test, nor does it assert the expected local-connection/no-other-attempt markers in the retry log. It also does not compare `retry["original_smoke_result_raw_sha256"]` with the retained original smoke-result file. The inspected artifacts currently contain the expected exact node and log markers, but the preflight does not enforce those facts; add those narrow assertions if the script must guarantee the exact retry claim rather than rely on later human review.

The focused runner executes its seven commands serially: Black, isort, Ruff, the real Admin browser test, the transaction API-edge selection, then the two Data Center inventory checks. It verifies the frozen source/projection pins around each command and enforces the expected browser/API pass, failure, skip, and deselection counts. Both inventory scripts write only with `--write`; their default invocation is a stale-check, so omitting `--check` is correct.

The Root5 browser test matches the previously reviewed thread-isolation candidate. AST inspection found six ORM helpers decorated to run in a one-worker `ThreadPoolExecutor`; `connections.close_all()` runs in the worker's `finally`. User/permission creation, fixture inserts, refreshes, audit reads, and transaction counts are confined to those helpers. Browser action call streams, test signatures/markers, and the exact-origin HTTP/WebSocket guard are unchanged. The previous Root4 browser result remains the failed evidence; this review does not promote the Root5 candidate to tested or passed.

Root reported the Domain phase green. The smoke failure and isolated retry details above were confirmed by reading the already-written result, log, and JUnit artifacts; no QA or retry was run during this review. Root's subsequent smoke phase status remains external to this memo.

# Fee A Root6 closeout drivers: static review

Reviewed only `.tmp/finalize_fee_a_root6_records.py` and `.tmp/commit_fee_a_root6.py`; no driver, QA, Git operation, database, or project import was run. This memo is bound to the current raw bytes:

- `finalize_fee_a_root6_records.py`: `a98bd86815bed70ad2b97912f2efd7ff07b627a92251f80c461ad5eab8d1d754`
- `commit_fee_a_root6.py`: `15433a3c5a411f5327e4b1d8dfefface0168342f7d1b6c48d206fbdd9c620cb2`

## Evidence state observed

Root6 reference exists at `.tmp/fee-a-bbc7-root-6-reference.json` (raw SHA `06810b1dceb19d38b18bd25fcd8fcfee3cabfa5d8c18b9761d64213d51c00541`), with base `bbc7d69ff930b6f95a658b7b800837166e263618`, source tree `9f8cdf1b837e70cb93fae8482ebebe281db8635a`, source commit `5c8005213e0659327c2b22cf51ac2b34a21c75c3`. Revision proof exists (`e217bc4692a9d70722af47f7bc8737b517797d23b5dd5086fc7f73b10151e726`); projection review exists (`d03a20d61122377518348152c99a325ae1c4f2b9a5c51b05e5b20c05bc339be5`) and reports `strict_delta: true`. Root6 focused result is now `passed` with 7 records, including 3 browser, 9 API-edge, three style, and two projection checks (raw SHA `5e03b0ccab2bfd7696e401f7674e66a62635a2f05c70186a09414b21ab3e0ce0`). The Root6 acceptance-review, postdoc-result, finalization-result, and commit-result files were absent at inspection time, so those later stages are not claimed complete.

## Static assessment

The acceptance chain is well connected at the current closeout seam. Finalization requires caller-provided raw pins for the acceptance and postdoc report, checks the Root6 tree/reference identity, binds the postdoc driver hash, checks all three expected records/log hashes and the eight-test JUnit with no failure/error/skip, verifies all 48 owned-path raw hashes plus base HEAD and the unchanged main index, and requires the same acceptance binding on checkpoint, bundle, and postdoc report. The new artifact guard requires `root5_acceptance_binding.py` in `accepted.artifacts_raw_sha256` and rehashes every listed artifact. Commit repeats those accepted-artifact checks, pins the finalization result/driver, requires the binding chain through finalization, and rechecks exact source/projection hashes.

The 48-path scope is internally consistent: 35 frozen owned paths + 9 official outputs + 4 book paths (plan, active registry, checkpoint, bundle), with uniqueness checked. The protected two tests are outside that scope. Their raw hashes and exact porcelain statuses are checked; the settlement test’s intent-to-add index flag is checked; the pre-stage index hash and empty cached diff are required. The status-path comparison at commit preflight is correct: `line[3:]` is compared with protected-status **keys** (paths). After commit, full porcelain lines are compared with protected-status **values**. The staged name set must equal the 48 approved paths and `git diff --cached --check` must pass before the commit call.

The active-plan registry gate is frozen by the postdoc’s raw hash: commit requires the current bytes to match the postdoc pin, and the finalization is limited to three other files. The drivers only constrain the registry change to version `v267` plus `next_gate`; they deliberately copy the live `next_gate` into the expected value. Per Root’s stated workflow, correctness of the publisher-authored gate must therefore be manually reviewed before postdoc freeze; after that, the 48-path hash prevents drift. This is not an after-freeze bypass, but the scripts do not validate the gate’s prose semantics themselves.

One evidence-coverage caveat remains for the upcoming Root6 acceptance artifact: the closeout drivers verify that the helper is present and rehash every entry in `artifacts_raw_sha256`, but they do not enforce a minimum key set beyond that helper. The acceptance producer must include the Root6 reference, revision proof, projection review, focused result and its logs/JUnit (plus the acceptance driver as applicable); otherwise an omitted artifact is not covered by this loop. The acceptance JSON does not yet exist, so its actual key set could not be checked.

Neither script claims commit rollback. The commit driver stages and then invokes `git commit`; assertions after that call are postconditions, not a rollback mechanism. If a post-commit assertion fails, the commit may already exist; if staging fails partway, the index may be partially staged. Treat a failure after the first `git add` as a state requiring inspection, and do not blindly rerun. Finalization also writes its three metadata files sequentially after prechecks; there is no multi-file atomic transaction.

def sha256_path(path: Path) -> str:
    """Return the raw SHA-256 of a file without normalizing its bytes."""
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def git_blob_oid(raw: bytes) -> str:
    """Compute a Git blob object ID with the repository's SHA-1 object format."""
    header = f"blob {len(raw)}\0".encode("ascii")
    import hashlib as _hashlib

    return _hashlib.sha1(header + raw).hexdigest()


def load_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Read one UTF-8 JSON object."""
    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise AssertionError(f"expected JSON object: {path}")
    return value

    changed_blobs = {path for path in root4_paths | final_paths if root4_blobs.get(path) != final_blobs.get(path)}
    _require(changed_blobs == ROOT5_CHANGED_PATHS, "Root4→Root6 Git blob delta differs from approved paths")
    root4_export, final_export = Path(root4_ref["export"]), Path(root5_ref["export"])
    for path in root4_paths:
        raw = (root4_export / Path(*PurePosixPath(path).parts)).read_bytes()
        _require(hashlib.sha256(raw.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest() == root4_lf[path],
                 f"Root4 export LF source pin mismatch: {path}")
        _require(git_blob_oid(raw) == root4_blobs[path], f"Root4 export blob ID mismatch: {path}")
    for path in final_paths:
        raw = (final_export / Path(*PurePosixPath(path).parts)).read_bytes()
        _require(hashlib.sha256(raw.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest() == final_lf[path],
                 f"Root6 export LF source pin mismatch: {path}")
        _require(git_blob_oid(raw) == final_blobs[path], f"Root6 export blob ID mismatch: {path}")
        live = root / Path(*PurePosixPath(path).parts)
        _require(live.is_file(), f"Root6 live source is missing: {path}")
        _require(hashlib.sha256(live.read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest() == final_lf[path],
                 f"Root6 live source LF differs from frozen export: {path}")

    intermediate_ref_path = root / ".tmp" / "fee-a-bbc7-root-5-reference.json"
    intermediate_proof_path = root / ".tmp" / "fee-a-bbc7-root-5-revision-proof.json"
    _require(sha256_path(intermediate_ref_path) == ROOT5_INTERMEDIATE_REFERENCE_SHA256
             and sha256_path(intermediate_proof_path) == ROOT5_INTERMEDIATE_PROOF_SHA256,
             "intermediate Root5 source lineage pins mismatch")
    intermediate_ref, intermediate_proof = load_json(intermediate_ref_path), load_json(intermediate_proof_path)
    _require(root5_ref.get("prior_source_tree") == root4_ref.get("source_tree")
             and root5_ref.get("prior_source_commit") == root4_ref.get("source_commit")
             and root5_ref.get("prior_reference_raw_sha256") == sha256_path(root4_ref_path),
             "Root6 frozen reference does not bind its Root4 source preimage")
    _require(set(root5_ref.get("only_changed_vs_prior", [])) == ROOT5_CHANGED_PATHS
             and proof.get("root5_only_selector_literal_ast_change") is True,
             "Root4→Root6 delta or Root5→Root6 selector proof changed")
    intermediate_blobs = intermediate_proof.get("root5_git_blob_oids", {})
    _require(set(intermediate_blobs) == final_paths, "intermediate Root5 Git blob proof is incomplete")
    _require({path for path in final_paths if intermediate_blobs.get(path) != final_blobs.get(path)} == {ROOT4_BROWSER},
             "Root5→Root6 blob delta exceeds the browser selector path")

    _require(proof.get("root4_official_output_blob_oids") == proof.get("root5_official_output_blob_oids")
             and set(proof.get("root5_official_output_blob_oids", {})) == set(root5_ref["official_outputs"]),
             "Root6 official projection blob proof is incomplete or changed")
    _require(root4_projection_review.get("strict_delta") is True
             and set(root4_projection_review.get("output_lf_sha256", {})) == set(root5_ref["official_outputs"]),
             "Root4 projection review is not strict or does not match the nine-output whitelist")
    _require(proof.get("root5_official_output_lf_sha256") == root4_projection_review["output_lf_sha256"],
             "Root6 official output LF pins differ from approved Root4 outputs")
    for path, pin in root4_projection_review["output_lf_sha256"].items():
        old_raw = (root4_export / Path(*PurePosixPath(path).parts)).read_bytes()
        new_raw = (final_export / Path(*PurePosixPath(path).parts)).read_bytes()
        _require(hashlib.sha256(old_raw.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest() == pin
                 and hashlib.sha256(new_raw.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest() == pin,
                 f"Root4/Root6 official output LF pin mismatch: {path}")
        _require(git_blob_oid(old_raw) == proof["root4_official_output_blob_oids"][path]
                 and git_blob_oid(new_raw) == proof["root5_official_output_blob_oids"][path],
                 f"Root4/Root6 official output blob mismatch: {path}")
    _require(final_projection_review.get("strict_delta") is True
             and final_projection_review.get("source_tree") == root5_ref["source_tree"]
             and final_projection_review.get("source_commit") == root5_ref["source_commit"]
             and final_projection_review.get("revision_proof_raw_sha256") == expected_proof_sha256,
             "Root6 focused projection review identity/proof mismatch")
    _require(final_projection_review.get("origin_projection_review_raw_sha256") == ROOT4_PROJECTION_REVIEW_SHA256
             and final_projection_review.get("output_lf_sha256") == root4_projection_review["output_lf_sha256"],
             "Root6 focused projection review differs from approved Root4 outputs")
    return {
        "final_revision_label": "Root6",
        "root4": {"base": root4_ref["base"], "source_commit": root4_ref["source_commit"],
                  "source_tree": root4_ref["source_tree"], "reference_raw_sha256": sha256_path(root4_ref_path)},
        "root5": {"base": root5_ref["base"], "source_commit": root5_ref["source_commit"],
                  "source_tree": root5_ref["source_tree"], "reference_raw_sha256": expected_root5_ref_sha256},
        "intermediate_root5": {"base": intermediate_ref["base"],
                                "source_commit": intermediate_ref["source_commit"],
                                "source_tree": intermediate_ref["source_tree"],
                                "reference_raw_sha256": sha256_path(intermediate_ref_path)},
        "revision_proof_raw_sha256": expected_proof_sha256,
        "changed_paths": sorted(ROOT5_CHANGED_PATHS),
        "official_outputs": sorted(root5_ref["official_outputs"]),
        "official_output_lf_sha256": root4_projection_review["output_lf_sha256"],
        "official_outputs_unchanged": True,
    }


def validate_root4_green_subset(*, root: Path, prefix: str, root4_ref: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Validate Root4 phases that passed; browser/API failures are checked separately."""
    expected_labels = {
        "generate": {"matrix", "schema", "openapi-yaml", "openapi-json", "module-map", "dictionary",
                     "dc-architecture", "dc-entrypoints"},
        "static": {"black", "isort", "ruff", "incremental-mypy", "full-mypy-debt"},
        "governance": {"architecture", "module-cycles", "changed-size", "inventory-check", "module-map",
                       "data-dictionary", "data-center-projections", "current-contracts", "audit-contracts",
                       "celery-contracts", "full-governance", "versioned-retirement"},
        "main": {"suite"}, "migration": {"0067"},
    }
    artifacts: dict[str, str] = {}
    summaries: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
    for phase, labels in expected_labels.items():
        path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-{phase}-result.json"
        data = load_json(path)
        _require(data.get("status") == "commands_finished_review_required", f"Root4 {phase} report status mismatch")
        _require(data.get("base") == root4_ref["base"] and data.get("source_commit") == root4_ref["source_commit"]
                 and data.get("source_tree") == root4_ref["source_tree"], f"Root4 {phase} source identity mismatch")
        _require(data.get("driver_raw_sha256") == ROOT4_PHASE_DRIVER_SHA256, f"Root4 {phase} phase-driver pin mismatch")
        _require(data.get("reference_raw_sha256") == ROOT4_REFERENCE_SHA256,
                 f"Root4 {phase} reference raw pin mismatch")
        _require({row.get("label") for row in data.get("records", [])} == labels, f"Root4 {phase} labels changed")
        _require(len(data["records"]) == len(labels), f"Root4 {phase} has duplicate/missing labels")
        artifacts[str(path.relative_to(root))] = sha256_path(path)
        for row in data["records"]:
            _require(row.get("exit_code") == 0, f"Root4 {phase}/{row.get('label')} was not green")
            log = Path(row["log"])
            _require(log.is_relative_to(root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-{phase}-logs"), f"Root4 {phase} log path escaped")
            _require(sha256_path(log) == row.get("log_raw_sha256"), f"Root4 {phase} log pin mismatch")
            artifacts[str(log.relative_to(root))] = row["log_raw_sha256"]
            if row.get("junit"):
                junit = Path(row["junit"])
                _require(junit.is_relative_to(Path(root4_ref["export"]) / ".tmp"), f"Root4 {phase} JUnit escaped export")
                _require(sha256_path(junit) == row.get("junit_raw_sha256"), f"Root4 {phase} JUnit pin mismatch")
                cases = list(ET.parse(junit).iter("testcase"))
                counts = {"total": len(cases),
                          "failed": sum(case.find("failure") is not None for case in cases),
                          "errors": sum(case.find("error") is not None for case in cases),
                          "skipped": sum(case.find("skipped") is not None for case in cases)}
                counts["passed"] = counts["total"] - counts["failed"] - counts["errors"] - counts["skipped"]
                _require(counts == row.get("counts") and counts["failed"] == counts["errors"] == counts["skipped"] == 0,
                         f"Root4 {phase} JUnit counts mismatch")
                _require([case.attrib for case in cases] == row.get("actual_nodes"), f"Root4 {phase} JUnit node mismatch")
                if phase == "main":
                    _require(counts["passed"] == 432 and row.get("deselected") == 7, "Root4 main suite count mismatch")
                if phase == "migration":
                    _require(counts["passed"] == 1, "Root4 migration count mismatch")
                summaries[phase] = counts
                artifacts[str(junit.relative_to(root))] = row["junit_raw_sha256"]
            elif phase in {"main", "migration"}:
                raise AssertionError(f"Root4 {phase} successful pytest phase lacks JUnit evidence")
    native_path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-native-result.json"
    native = load_json(native_path)
    _require(native.get("status") == "passed" and native.get("source_tree") == root4_ref["source_tree"]
             and native.get("source_commit") == root4_ref["source_commit"], "Root4 native identity/status mismatch")
    native_driver = root / ".tmp" / "run_fee_a_native_root4.py"
    _require(sha256_path(native_driver) == ROOT4_NATIVE_DRIVER_SHA256
             and native.get("driver_raw_sha256") == ROOT4_NATIVE_DRIVER_SHA256, "Root4 native driver pin mismatch")
    _require(native.get("counts") == {"total": 7, "passed": 7, "failed": 0, "errors": 0, "skipped": 0},
             "Root4 native test counts mismatch")
    _require(native.get("parent_read_only_and_unchanged") is True, "Root4 native parent safety flag mismatch")
    artifacts[str(native_path.relative_to(root))] = sha256_path(native_path)
    artifacts[str(native_driver.relative_to(root))] = ROOT4_NATIVE_DRIVER_SHA256
    coverage_path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-coverage-review.json"
    coverage = load_json(coverage_path)
    _require(coverage.get("status") == "passed" and coverage.get("source_tree") == root4_ref["source_tree"],
             "Root4 coverage-review identity/status mismatch")
    _require(bool(coverage.get("layers")) and all(row.get("line_floor_passed") is True
                                                   for row in coverage["layers"].values()),
             "Root4 coverage floor evidence is incomplete")
    artifacts[str(coverage_path.relative_to(root))] = sha256_path(coverage_path)
    return {"root4_green_phases": summaries, "root4_native_counts": native["counts"],
            "root4_coverage_layers": coverage["layers"], "artifacts_raw_sha256": artifacts}


def validate_root4_failed_history(
    *, root: Path, prefix: str, sequence: dict[str, Any],
    root4_ref: dict[str, Any],
    sequence_driver: Path, root4_browser_result: dict[str, Any],
    remaining: dict[str, Any], remaining_driver: Path,
    root4_api_edge_result: dict[str, Any], phase_driver: Path,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Keep Root4 browser/API-edge failures as historical non-green evidence."""
    sequence_path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-db-sequence.json"
    browser_result_path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-browser-result.json"
    api_result_path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-api-edges-result.json"
    remaining_path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-remaining-checks.json"
    _require(sha256_path(sequence_path) == ROOT4_SEQUENCE_RESULT_SHA256, "Root4 sequence report raw pin mismatch")
    _require(sha256_path(browser_result_path) == ROOT4_BROWSER_RESULT_SHA256, "Root4 browser report raw pin mismatch")
    _require(sha256_path(api_result_path) == ROOT4_API_RESULT_SHA256, "Root4 API-edge report raw pin mismatch")
    _require(sha256_path(remaining_path) == ROOT4_REMAINING_RESULT_SHA256, "Root4 continuation report raw pin mismatch")
    _require(load_json(sequence_path) == sequence and load_json(browser_result_path) == root4_browser_result
             and load_json(api_result_path) == root4_api_edge_result and load_json(remaining_path) == remaining,
             "Root4 failure inputs differ from the pinned history artifacts")
    _require(sequence.get("status") == "stopped_on_failure", "Root4 DB sequence must retain its stopped status")
    _require(sha256_path(sequence_driver) == ROOT4_SEQUENCE_DRIVER_SHA256, "Root4 sequence driver changed")
    _require(sequence.get("driver_raw_sha256") == ROOT4_SEQUENCE_DRIVER_SHA256, "Root4 sequence driver pin mismatch")
    _require(sequence.get("source_tree") in (None, root4_ref["source_tree"]), "Root4 sequence source identity mismatch")
    _require(sequence.get("source_commit") in (None, root4_ref["source_commit"]), "Root4 sequence commit identity mismatch")
    rows = sequence.get("records", [])
    _require([row.get("phase") for row in rows] == ROOT4_SEQUENCE_PHASES, "Root4 sequence phase order mismatch")
    _require([row.get("exit_code") for row in rows] == ROOT4_SEQUENCE_EXIT_CODES, "Root4 failed sequence history mismatch")
    python = str(root / "agomtradepro/Scripts/python.exe")
    expected_commands = [
        [python, "-X", "utf8", ".tmp/run_fee_a_bbc7_root4_phase.py", "main"],
        [python, "-X", "utf8", ".tmp/run_fee_a_bbc7_root4_phase.py", "migration"],
        [python, "-X", "utf8", ".tmp/run_fee_a_native_root4.py"],
        [python, "-X", "utf8", ".tmp/run_fee_a_bbc7_root4_phase.py", "browser"],
    ]
    _require([row.get("command") for row in rows] == expected_commands, "Root4 sequence argv mismatch")
    browser_rows = root4_browser_result.get("records", [])
    _require(sha256_path(phase_driver) == ROOT4_PHASE_DRIVER_SHA256, "Root4 phase driver changed")
    _require(root4_browser_result.get("source_tree") == root4_ref["source_tree"], "Root4 browser source tree mismatch")
    _require(root4_browser_result.get("source_commit") == root4_ref["source_commit"], "Root4 browser source commit mismatch")
    _require(root4_browser_result.get("driver_raw_sha256") == ROOT4_PHASE_DRIVER_SHA256, "Root4 browser driver pin mismatch")
    _require(len(browser_rows) == 1 and browser_rows[0].get("label") == "admin", "Root4 browser result shape mismatch")
    browser = browser_rows[0]
    _require(browser.get("exit_code") != 0, "Root4 browser failure was incorrectly changed to green")
    counts = browser.get("counts", {})
    _require(counts.get("total") == 3 and counts.get("failed", 0) + counts.get("errors", 0) == 3,
             "Root4 browser failure history no longer matches the three observed failures")
    browser_log = Path(browser["log"])
    _require(browser_log.is_relative_to(root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-browser-logs"), "Root4 browser log escaped its evidence directory")
    _require(sha256_path(browser_log) == browser.get("log_raw_sha256"), "Root4 browser log pin mismatch")
    _require("SynchronousOnlyOperation" in browser_log.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"),
             "Root4 browser failure signature is missing")

    _require(remaining.get("status") == "stopped_on_failure", "Root4 continuation failure history must be retained")
    _require(sha256_path(remaining_driver) == ROOT4_REMAINING_DRIVER_SHA256, "Root4 continuation driver changed")
    _require(remaining.get("driver_raw_sha256") == ROOT4_REMAINING_DRIVER_SHA256, "Root4 continuation driver pin mismatch")
    remaining_rows = remaining.get("records", [])
    _require(len(remaining_rows) == 1 and remaining_rows[0].get("phase") == "api-edges"
             and remaining_rows[0].get("exit_code") == 1, "Root4 API-edge failure history mismatch")
    _require(remaining_rows[0].get("driver_raw_sha256") == ROOT4_PHASE_DRIVER_SHA256,
             "Root4 API-edge phase driver pin mismatch")
    api_rows = root4_api_edge_result.get("records", [])
    _require(root4_api_edge_result.get("source_tree") == root4_ref["source_tree"], "Root4 API-edge source tree mismatch")
    _require(root4_api_edge_result.get("source_commit") == root4_ref["source_commit"], "Root4 API-edge source commit mismatch")
    _require(root4_api_edge_result.get("driver_raw_sha256") == ROOT4_PHASE_DRIVER_SHA256, "Root4 API-edge driver pin mismatch")
    _require(len(api_rows) == 1 and api_rows[0].get("label") == "transaction" and api_rows[0].get("exit_code") == 1,
             "Root4 API-edge result must remain failed history")
    _require(api_rows[0].get("counts") == ROOT4_API_EDGE_FAILURE_COUNTS and api_rows[0].get("deselected") == 59,
             "Root4 API-edge historical counts changed")
    api_log = Path(api_rows[0]["log"])
    _require(api_log.is_relative_to(root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-api-edges-logs"),
             "Root4 API-edge failure log escaped its evidence directory")
    _require(sha256_path(api_log) == api_rows[0].get("log_raw_sha256"),
             "Root4 API-edge failure log raw pin mismatch")
    artifacts = {
        str(sequence_path.relative_to(root)): sha256_path(sequence_path),
        str(browser_result_path.relative_to(root)): sha256_path(browser_result_path),
        str(api_result_path.relative_to(root)): sha256_path(api_result_path),
        str(remaining_path.relative_to(root)): sha256_path(remaining_path),
        str(sequence_driver.relative_to(root)): ROOT4_SEQUENCE_DRIVER_SHA256,
        str(remaining_driver.relative_to(root)): ROOT4_REMAINING_DRIVER_SHA256,
        str(phase_driver.relative_to(root)): ROOT4_PHASE_DRIVER_SHA256,
        str(browser_log.relative_to(root)): browser["log_raw_sha256"],
        str(api_log.relative_to(root)): api_rows[0]["log_raw_sha256"],
    }
    return {"root4_identity": {"base": root4_ref["base"], "source_commit": root4_ref["source_commit"],
                                "source_tree": root4_ref["source_tree"]},
            "root4_browser_failure": browser, "root4_api_edge_failure": api_rows[0],
            "root4_db_sequence_status": sequence["status"], "root4_remaining_status": remaining["status"],
            "artifacts_raw_sha256": artifacts}


def validate_root4_domain_smoke(
    *, root: Path, root4_ref: dict[str, Any], expected_sequence_sha256: str,
    expected_smoke_report_sha256: str, expected_smoke_retry_path: Path,
    expected_smoke_retry_sha256: str, expected_smoke_retry_driver_path: Path,
    expected_smoke_retry_driver_sha256: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Validate Domain, preserve the failed aggregate smoke, and verify exact retry.

    The Domain driver reported no JUnit field because it searched the wrong
    Windows path. Its log records the actual generated XML path; read and pin
    that XML without modifying either original report. The aggregate smoke's
    one failure remains history; a separate exact-node retry has its own pins.
    """
    prefix = "fee-a-bbc7-root-4"
    sequence_path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-domain-smoke-sequence.json"
    domain_path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-domain-result.json"
    smoke_path = root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-smoke-result.json"
    smoke_retry_path = expected_smoke_retry_path.resolve()
    _require(sha256_path(sequence_path) == expected_sequence_sha256, "Root4 Domain/smoke sequence raw pin mismatch")
    _require(sha256_path(domain_path) == ROOT4_DOMAIN_REPORT_SHA256, "Root4 Domain report raw pin mismatch")
    _require(sha256_path(smoke_path) == expected_smoke_report_sha256, "Root4 smoke report raw pin mismatch")
    _require(smoke_retry_path.is_relative_to((root / ".tmp").resolve()),
             "Root4 exact smoke retry report escaped ignored evidence")
    _require(sha256_path(smoke_retry_path) == expected_smoke_retry_sha256,
             "Root4 exact smoke retry report raw pin mismatch")
    sequence = load_json(sequence_path)
    domain = load_json(domain_path)
    smoke = load_json(smoke_path)

    sequence_driver = root / ".tmp" / "run_fee_a_root4_domain_smoke.py"
    domain_driver = root / ".tmp" / "run_fee_a_root4_domain_with_junit.py"
    smoke_driver = root / ".tmp" / "run_fee_a_root4_smoke.py"
    _require(sha256_path(sequence_driver) == ROOT4_DOMAIN_SEQUENCE_DRIVER_SHA256,
             "Root4 Domain/smoke sequence driver changed")
    _require(sha256_path(domain_driver) == ROOT4_DOMAIN_DRIVER_SHA256, "Root4 Domain driver changed")
    _require(sha256_path(smoke_driver) == ROOT4_SMOKE_DRIVER_SHA256, "Root4 smoke driver changed")
    _require(sequence.get("status") == "stopped_on_failure",
             "Root4 initial Domain/smoke stop-on-failure history changed")
    _require(sequence.get("driver_raw_sha256") == ROOT4_DOMAIN_SEQUENCE_DRIVER_SHA256,
             "Root4 Domain/smoke sequence driver pin mismatch")
    python = str(root / "agomtradepro/Scripts/python.exe")
    sequence_records = sequence.get("records", [])
    _require([row.get("phase") for row in sequence_records] == ["domain", "smoke"],
             "Root4 Domain/smoke sequence order mismatch")
    _require([row.get("exit_code") for row in sequence_records] == [0, 1],
             "Root4 initial Domain/smoke exit history changed")
    expected_commands = [
        [python, "-X", "utf8", str(domain_driver), "domain"],
        [python, "-X", "utf8", str(smoke_driver), "smoke"],
    ]
    _require([row.get("command") for row in sequence_records] == expected_commands,
             "Root4 Domain/smoke sequence argv mismatch")
    _require([row.get("driver_raw_sha256") for row in sequence_records]
             == [ROOT4_DOMAIN_DRIVER_SHA256, ROOT4_SMOKE_DRIVER_SHA256],
             "Root4 Domain/smoke phase driver pins mismatch")
    artifacts: dict[str, str] = {
        str(sequence_path.relative_to(root)): sha256_path(sequence_path),
        str(domain_path.relative_to(root)): sha256_path(domain_path),
        str(smoke_path.relative_to(root)): sha256_path(smoke_path),
        str(sequence_driver.relative_to(root)): ROOT4_DOMAIN_SEQUENCE_DRIVER_SHA256,
        str(domain_driver.relative_to(root)): ROOT4_DOMAIN_DRIVER_SHA256,
        str(smoke_driver.relative_to(root)): ROOT4_SMOKE_DRIVER_SHA256,
    }

    for phase, data, driver, expected_label in (
        ("domain", domain, domain_driver, "line-gate"),
        ("smoke", smoke, smoke_driver, "minimum-regression"),
    ):
        _require(data.get("phase") == phase and data.get("status") == "commands_finished_review_required",
                 f"Root4 {phase} phase report status mismatch")
        _require(data.get("base") == root4_ref["base"]
                 and data.get("source_tree") == root4_ref["source_tree"]
                 and data.get("source_commit") == root4_ref["source_commit"],
                 f"Root4 {phase} report source identity mismatch")
        _require(data.get("reference_raw_sha256") == sha256_path(root / ".tmp" / "fee-a-bbc7-root-4-reference.json"),
                 f"Root4 {phase} report reference pin mismatch")
        _require(data.get("driver_raw_sha256") == sha256_path(driver), f"Root4 {phase} report driver pin mismatch")
        rows = data.get("records", [])
        _require(len(rows) == 1 and rows[0].get("label") == expected_label and rows[0].get("exit_code") == 0,
                 f"Root4 {phase} phase result shape/status mismatch")
        row = rows[0]
        log = Path(row["log"])
        _require(log.is_relative_to(root / ".tmp" / f"{prefix}-{phase}-logs"),
                 f"Root4 {phase} log escaped its evidence directory")
        _require(sha256_path(log) == row.get("log_raw_sha256"), f"Root4 {phase} log pin mismatch")
        artifacts[str(log.relative_to(root))] = row["log_raw_sha256"]
        if phase == "domain":
            _require("junit" not in row and "counts" not in row,
                     "Root4 Domain report must retain its original missing-JUnit metadata")
            log_text = log.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

def validate_projection_whitelist(root: Path, export: Path, review: dict[str, Any], official_outputs: list[str]) -> dict[Path, bytes]:
    """Preflight every projection target before any shared target is written."""
    names = set(review.get("output_lf_sha256", {}))
    _require(names == set(official_outputs) and len(names) == 9, "projection output paths differ from the 9-path whitelist")
    root_resolved = root.resolve()
    writes: dict[Path, bytes] = {}
    targets: list[Path] = []
    for name, pin in review["output_lf_sha256"].items():
        relative = PurePosixPath(name)
        _require(not relative.is_absolute() and ".." not in relative.parts and "\\" not in name
                 and ":" not in name, f"unsafe output path: {name}")
        source = export.joinpath(*relative.parts)
        target = root.joinpath(*relative.parts)
        _require(source.resolve().is_relative_to(export.resolve()), f"export output escapes export: {name}")
        _require(target.resolve().is_relative_to(root_resolved), f"output target escapes repository: {name}")
        targets.append(target)
        raw = source.read_bytes()
        _require(hashlib.sha256(raw.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest() == pin, f"projection LF pin mismatch: {name}")
        _require(target not in writes, f"duplicate output target: {name}")
        writes[target] = raw
    # Check every destination directory in a separate pass before any caller writes.
    for target in targets:
        _require(target.parent.is_dir(), f"missing output parent before writes: {target}")
    return writes


def acceptance_binding(*, acceptance_path: Path, identity: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Create the cross-stage acceptance identity stored by publish/finalize."""
    return {"acceptance_raw_sha256": sha256_path(acceptance_path), "source_identity": identity}


def attach_acceptance_binding(
    *, record: dict[str, Any], acceptance_path: Path, identity: dict[str, Any]
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Attach the same immutable acceptance binding to a downstream record."""
    binding = acceptance_binding(acceptance_path=acceptance_path, identity=identity)
    prior = record.get("acceptance_binding")
    _require(prior in (None, binding), "record already carries a different acceptance binding")
    record["acceptance_binding"] = binding
    return record

    """Reject stale acceptance, root identity, or proof values in later stages."""

    *, records: list[dict[str, Any]], acceptance_path: Path, identity: dict[str, Any]

    """Compute a Git blob object ID with the repository's SHA-1 object format."""
